title: Klaviyo Flow Strategist
description:
About BLAC Willow

BLAC Willow is a lifecycle and retention partner for DTC and subscription brands. We work as a managed services team, not a traditional agency: we own retention strategy, execution and reporting for our clients, end to end.



THE ROLE

The Klaviyo Flow Strategist owns the automated flow program for a portfolio of 5–8 client brands. You find where flows are leaving revenue on the table, build the case, and see the fix through from brief to launch to results.

This is not a build-only role. You do not wait for direction. You audit, spot the gap, bring a recommendation to leadership, and then run it: briefs, copy and design coordination, QA, testing and reporting. You report to the Founder.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

-Flow analysis and opportunity

-Audit every live flow across your 5–8 clients: welcome, browse and cart abandonment, checkout, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, sunset and subscription flows

-Diagnose performance by flow, message and segment: revenue per recipient, conversion, click and placed-order rates, deliverability and drop-off between messages

-Identify missing flows, weak branches, timing problems and segmentation gaps

-Size each opportunity and rank it by revenue impact and effort



STRATEGY AND RECOMMENDATION

-Bring a prioritized opportunity list to the Founder each month, with the data behind each recommendation

-Build a testing roadmap per client: subject lines, offers, timing, message count, content and conditional splits

-Set a clear hypothesis and success metric for every test before it launches



EXECUTION, BRIEF TO LAUNCH

-Write flow briefs: goal, audience, triggers and filters, message map, timing, offer and copy direction

-Work directly with our copywriter and designer to deliver on-brief creative, on schedule

-Build or oversee the build in Klaviyo, then QA logic, triggers, filters, dynamic content and rendering before launch

-Monitor tests to significance, call winners and roll learnings into the next round

-Reporting

-Deliver monthly flow performance reports for each client

-Explain what moved, why it moved, and what comes next

-Present further opportunities to improve every flow in the program



WHO YOU ARE

-Proactive. You find the problem before anyone asks. You show up with the opportunity, the data and the plan, not a question about what to do next.

-Analytical. You live in Klaviyo reporting and know which metrics matter for each flow. You can explain why a number moved, not just that it did.

-Strategic. You connect flow performance to the client's business: margin, LTV, repeat purchase and subscription retention. You prioritize by impact, not by what is easiest.

-An owner. You manage multiple clients and timelines at once, keep creative partners on track, and close the loop on every launch.

-A clear communicator. You present findings to leadership and clients with confidence and a point of view.



REQUIREMENTS

-4+ years in
 or lifecycle marketing, with at least 3 years hands-on in Klaviyo

-A track record of building, auditing and optimizing Klaviyo flows for DTC or ecommerce brands

-Deep knowledge of Klaviyo flow logic: triggers, flow and trigger filters, conditional splits, A/B tests, dynamic content and segmentation

-Experience managing several brands at once in an agency or managed services setting

-Experience writing creative briefs and directing copywriters and designers

-Strong analytical skills, including attribution, statistical significance and revenue-per-recipient analysis

-Comfortable presenting results to internal leadership



NICE TO HAVE

-Shopify and subscription platform experience (Recharge, Skio or similar)

-SMS flow experience (Klaviyo SMS, Attentive or Postscript)

-Basic HTML and CSS for

-Klaviyo certification

-Experience in a subscription or replenishment business



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 15 days: Full flow audit completed for every client in your portfolio, with a ranked opportunity list presented to the Founder.

First 45 days: Priority flow builds and fixes briefed and in production, and a testing roadmap live for each client.

First 60 days: Tests running on every account, new flows launched, and a monthly reporting rhythm in place that shows flow revenue growth by client.



LOGISTICS AND HOW TO APPLY

Location: Remote, working Eastern Time (EST) business hours

Type: Contract

Compensation: $6/hour



To apply, send your resume and a short note about a Klaviyo flow you improved: what you found, what you changed, and the result.

Do not use dancing, party, or ceremony footage, even if it appears in the supplied reception timeline. You submit only full-timeline screenshots and low-quality previews uploaded to 
. No Premiere project file is requested. Instructions and all test materials are supplied.

3. Confirmation that your PayPal account is active and can RECEIVE payments.

4. Confirmation that you can reliably attend the initial training hours and complete assignments. If you have another job, please make sure the schedule is realistic before applying.

5. If you have wedding-editing experience, one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional.



We value reliability, careful work and a willingness to learn. We look forward to meeting our next long-term team member.

title: Creative Strategist / DTC Ad Copywriter – Meta Video Ads (Long-Term)
description:
Read the whole post. Applications that don't follow the format at the bottom are deleted unread. We're not being difficult — we get a lot of applications and this is how we find you.



We're Klyr, a men's skincare and concealer brand selling internationally. We spend serious money on Meta every month and creative is the only lever that matters to us. We want one Creative Strategist to own our ad concepts and scripts long-term.



You should have experience writing direct-response video ads for DTC brands. If you're a copywriter with strong ad scripts, we'd like to hear from you too. If your portfolio is mostly blogs, SEO or social captions, this isn't your job.



What you'd be doing



Researching customer reviews, comments and competitor ads to find buying motivations and objections

Turning those insights into ad angles and ready-to-edit scripts for Meta

Writing hook variants — same body, 4–6 different openings, tested against each other

Writing UGC, product demonstration and AI voiceover scripts

Briefing our editor with clear direction: spoken words, visuals, footage and proof

Reviewing edits and giving specific feedback before ads go live

Using performance data to improve scripts and turn winning ads into new variations



How we work



Our creative is organised as hooks (H1–H4) against angles — Redness, Pimples, Men Over 50, Women's vs Men's — against problem-aware and solution-aware audiences. If that framework is familiar, you'll fit here immediately.



You'll work directly with us and our video editor. We want someone who brings ideas, explains the thinking behind them and knows what to test next.



AI tools are welcome. Sending us unedited ChatGPT scripts isn't.



What we're looking for



Experience writing DTC ad scripts, ideally for Meta

Natural spoken English — scripts that sound like a person, not a landing page

Strong understanding of hooks, awareness levels, objections and proof

Ability to connect creative decisions to ad performance

Skincare or beauty experience is a plus, not a requirement



What we offer



Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project.

Mostly async. 2–3 hours daily overlap with Amsterdam, reply within 4 working hours.

15 paid days off per year plus Philippine public holidays

Paid test assignment before we hire — you're paid whether or not we take you



How to apply



 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:



[Your name] | [years writing DTC ads] | [brand from your example]



Example: Maria Santos | 3 | Brand Name



Then in the body, exactly these six numbered lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only for work samples.



1. Best DTC video ad you wrote: [link, plus what you personally contributed]

2. What it sold and how it performed: [if you didn't have access to results, say so]

3. Best moment in that ad: [timestamp (mm:ss) and why you wrote it that way, max 2 sentences]

4. New hook for that same ad: [write a different opening and explain which customer motivation it tests, max 3 sentences]

5. Klyr exercise: [a man wants to hide redness but worries concealer will look like makeup. Write the first 5 seconds: exact spoken words and what we see on screen. Don't invent product claims.]

6. Availability and expected monthly salary in USD:



For lines 4 and 5, keep it short. We don't need a full campaign. We want to see how you think and whether you can turn a specific customer problem into an opening worth watching.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, inaccessible links, a CV instead of examples, claiming work you didn't do, "I am hardworking and a fast learner", or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We reply to everyone who follows the format within 5 working days.



If you've read this far and it sounds like your kind of work, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Accountant / Senior Bookkeeper (Australian Experience) - Remote
description:
We're a registered training organisation and CRICOS college in Sydney (RTO 41257 / CRICOS 03622A), and we're looking for a Philippines-based remote accountant or bookkeeper who has done real Australian books, not just read about them.



First, what this job isn't. You won't log into our bank accounts, make or release payments, or lodge anything with the ATO. Our Managing Director handles all of that. Your job is to prepare and calculate, and to get the numbers right.



Here's what you'd actually be doing.



Agent commissions are a big part of the role. Education agents send us commission invoices, and you'll check them against student lists, the tuition we've actually received, commission rates and our commission-ban list. Then you'll prepare the payment request (the calculation only) and sort out agent statement reconciliations and part-payments.



You'll also calculate fortnightly payroll for our onshore staff and offshore trainers, and prepare the schedules for approval. You won't be changing TFNs or staff bank details.



On student fees, you'll create and maintain tuition invoices, instalment schedules and payment plans in aXcelerate, allocate incoming payments to student accounts, and run the arrears report on a set template.



At month-end, you'll prepare the bank reconciliation working papers from bank feeds and statements (no bank login needed) and reconcile aXcelerate receivables to MYOB. You'll also enter supplier bills, prepare payment batches, and put together the BAS and super working papers for the Managing Director to review and lodge.



There are a few things we can't compromise on. You need at least 3 years of Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience, and strong working knowledge of MYOB. We use MYOB, not Xero. You should have prepared BAS workpapers, super and STP data before, and be comfortable with Excel and month-end close. Your written English needs to be excellent, because you'll be
ing education agents overseas. You'll also need reliable internet, a dedicated home office, and to be happy with a background check and an NDA.



It's a bonus if you have a Philippine CPA licence, finance experience in education, RTOs or CRICOS colleges, experience with aXcelerate or another student management system, or can read and write Chinese.



The hours are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Sydney time, which comes to 32 hours a week. That's currently 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM PH time, and one hour later (8:00 AM to 4:00 PM) when Sydney daylight saving ends in April.



Interested? Send us your CV and a short note telling us:



1. How many years of Australian bookkeeping experience you have

2. Which MYOB version(s) you've used

3. Whether you've done agent commission reconciliation or education-sector accounting

4. Your expected hourly rate in AUD, and when you could start



If you're shortlisted, we'll ask you to do a practical test before we make a decision, and we'll pay you for your time.

title: Carrier Onboarding Representative
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Carrier Onboarding Representative to help identify, verify, onboard, and develop relationships with reliable trucking carriers across our priority markets.



This role is not just about adding carriers to our network. It is about building a dependable carrier base, maintaining strong relationships, and ensuring our operations teams have access to qualified carriers when capacity is needed.



Role Overview

You are responsible for sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with qualified carriers while supporting the growth and reliability of GH Logistics' carrier network. You will work directly with U.S.-based trucking companies to identify carriers operating in our priority markets, verify their qualifications, complete onboarding requirements, and maintain accurate carrier records.



This is a high volume and phone-based role that requires persistence, organization, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced freight environment. This role does not involve booking loads or negotiating freight rates. Your primary responsibility is to ensure qualified, verified carriers are properly onboarded, documented, and connected with the appropriate internal teams. This role is strictly for fluent English speakers, as the position requires constant communication with U.S.-based carriers and internal team members throughout the shift.



What You'll Be Doing



Carrier Sourcing and Network Development

• Make at least 30 outbound calls daily to identify and connect with potential carriers.

• Handle approximately 20 inbound calls daily related to carrier inquiries, onboarding, and follow-ups.

• Identify reliable carriers actively operating in GH Logistics' priority markets.

• Build professional relationships with carrier owners, dispatchers, and fleet representatives.

• Introduce GH Logistics and explain our carrier onboarding process, freight network, and communication expectations.

• Identify carrier operating areas, preferred lanes, equipment types, and availability.

• Follow up with existing carriers to maintain engagement and updated information.

• Focus on developing long-term carrier relationships rather than simply increasing onboarding numbers.



Carrier Verification and Fraud Prevention

• Verify carriers using approved tools

• Review carrier operating authority, insurance coverage, safety records, and compliance information.

• Check the company's Do Not Use (DNU) list before proceeding with onboarding.

• Identify potential red flags involving fraud, double brokering, or suspicious carrier information.

• Ensure all verification requirements are completed before onboarding a carrier.

• Escalate questionable carriers or compliance concerns to management.

• Follow company-approved verification procedures without skipping required steps.



Carrier Onboarding and Documentation

• Successfully onboard at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Complete all required carrier onboarding documentation accurately and efficiently.

• Ensure carrier information and compliance records are complete and up to date.

• Create at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier to establish direct communication.

• Immediately post every newly onboarded carrier in the designated channel.

• Ensure every onboarded carrier is properly recorded and accessible to the appropriate internal teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure newly onboarded carriers are ready for potential freight opportunities.



Carrier Relationship Management and Tracking

• Update and maintain spreadsheet daily.

• Track carrier onboarding activity, call volume, follow-ups, and carrier information.

• Maintain accurate carrier contact information, operating preferences, and relevant details.

• Monitor existing carrier records and update information as needed.

• Ensure all onboarded carriers are properly documented and included in the appropriate tracking systems.

• Maintain organized daily activity logs and communication records.

• Coordinate with internal teams to address carrier-related inquiries or concerns.



Directory and Communication Management

• Maintain the GH Logistics carrier directory and designated group chats.

• Add new contacts and remove outdated or inactive members as needed.

• Ensure appropriate team members are included in required communication groups.

• Maintain accurate group membership and required administrative access.

• Escalate missing information, access restrictions, or communication issues to management.

• Keep carrier communication organized, professional, and accessible to internal teams.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completes 30 outbound calls daily.

• Handles approximately 20 inbound calls daily.

• Successfully onboards at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Creates at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier.

• Every onboarded carrier is properly verified through approved tools.

• No carriers on the DNU list are onboarded.

• All newly onboarded carriers are immediately posted in the communication channel.

• Carrier records, tracking spreadsheets, and directories remain accurate and updated.

• Builds and maintains reliable carrier relationships that support long-term network growth.

• Consistently meets daily activity and onboarding targets without sacrificing quality.

• Demonstrates urgency, accountability, and strong communication in a fast-paced freight environment.



Who We're Looking For

• Experience in Carrier Onboarding, Carrier Sales, Freight Brokerage, Dispatch, or U.S. Trucking Operations is preferred.

• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Comfortable making high volume outbound calls and handling inbound carrier inquiries.

• Familiarity with U.S. carrier verification, insurance, operating authority, and safety compliance.

• Experience with logistiics platforms is a strong advantage.

• Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable managing multiple spreadsheets and communication channels.

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing carrier documentation and maintaining records.

• Proactive, persistent, and confident when communicating with trucking companies.

• Capable of building professional relationships and maintaining consistent carrier follow-ups.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-urgency freight environment.

• Performance-driven, KPI-oriented, and comfortable working with measurable daily targets.

• Follows instructions consistently and executes tasks with precision.

• Able to work independently while coordinating effectively with internal teams.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Available shift: Monday -  Friday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help build a reliable carrier network, prevent freight fraud through proper verification, and strengthen GH Logistics' capacity to support consistent freight coverage.

• Structured Workflows: Established carrier onboarding procedures, clear daily KPIs, organized tracking systems, and opportunities to improve carrier relationships and network efficiency.



If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a high-volume calling environment, and takes pride in building reliable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Track & Trace – Quality Assurance Team Lead (Brokerage Operations)
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven Track & Trace Quality Assurance Team Lead to oversee our QA operations, lead a team of remote associates, and ensure every booked load is properly verified before pickup. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong US freight brokerage experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment.



If you have experience managing logistics operations, identifying freight fraud risks, resolving escalations, and driving team performance, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, GH Logistics books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads.



As the Quality Assurance Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the team's daily workload, monitoring verification progress, reviewing operational accuracy, and ensuring that no critical verification steps are overlooked. You will serve as the primary point of escalation for unresolved driver verification issues, suspicious carrier activity, tracking discrepancies, and operational concerns that could affect pickup performance or shipment security.



Beyond supervising the team, you are expected to remain actively involved in operations, make timely decisions, identify process gaps, and ensure consistent execution of established SOPs. This is a working leadership role, not solely an administrative or supervisory position. You must be comfortable stepping into operational tasks, handling difficult situations, and taking ownership of your team's results.



What You'll Be Doing



Team Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and supervise the Quality Assurance team, ensuring all assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• Distribute workloads based on shipment volume, urgency, team capacity, and operational priorities.

• Monitor individual and team productivity, task completion, verification accuracy, and overall performance.

• Ensure team members consistently follow established SOPs, verification procedures, and documentation standards.

• Provide real-time guidance, coaching, and corrective feedback to improve individual and team performance.

• Identify performance gaps, recurring errors, and accountability concerns, and escalate them to management when necessary.

• Maintain clear shift handovers, ensuring pending verifications, unresolved issues, and critical follow-ups are properly communicated.

• Take ownership of daily QA execution and ensure operational priorities are completed without unnecessary delays.



Load Verification, Quality Control & Fraud Prevention

• Oversee the verification process for booked loads, ensuring rate confirmations are sent to the correct carriers.

• Ensure driver information, carrier details, and load assignments are complete, accurate, and properly documented.

• Review CDL verification results and ensure required identity verification procedures are followed.

• Monitor compliance with driver check calls, tracking assignments, and pre-pickup verification requirements.

• Conduct quality checks and spot audits to identify incomplete verifications, documentation errors, and procedural violations.

• Investigate inconsistencies involving driver identities, carrier information, contact numbers, and shipment assignments.

• Identify potential freight fraud, identity mismatches, double-brokering indicators, and other suspicious activities.

• Immediately escalate high-risk concerns to Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management.

• Ensure questionable or unverified assignments are escalated and appropriately resolved before freight movement.



Escalation Management & Operational Decision-Making

• Serve as the first point of escalation for QA associates handling complex or unresolved verification issues.

• Investigate discrepancies between rate confirmations, TMS records, carrier instructions, driver information, and shipment documents.

• Make timely, informed decisions within established authority and escalate matters requiring management approval.

• Coordinate with Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, and Operations to resolve verification delays, missing information, and potential service failures.

• Prioritize urgent operational concerns based on fraud risk, pickup deadlines, shipment impact, and customer requirements.

• Ensure unresolved issues are properly documented, assigned, and followed through until resolution.

• Communicate critical i
 to management with clear findings, actions taken, and recommended next steps.



Driver Coordination & Tracking Oversight

• Ensure assigned drivers are contacted and properly informed of pickup and delivery details, appointment times, and equipment requirements.

• Oversee the accuracy of driver information entered into the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Monitor GPS tracking assignments and ensure tracking readiness before scheduled pickups.

• Ensure CDL verification links are sent and outstanding requirements are followed up on promptly.

• Verify that team-driver assignments meet the required confirmation procedures.

• Step in to conduct driver or dispatcher calls when necessary to resolve urgent issues or support the team.

• Ensure no assigned load is overlooked due to incomplete follow-ups or unclear ownership.



Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track daily QA performance, including load verification completion, documentation accuracy, outstanding requirements, and unresolved escalations.

• Monitor individual productivity and identify associates who require additional coaching or support.

• Prepare clear operational updates and performance reports for management.

• Review recurring verification errors, missed follow-ups, and operational bottlenecks.

• Recommend improvements to workflows, verification procedures, and quality control processes.

• Support onboarding and training of new QA associates to ensure they understand operational expectations and SOPs.

• Promote a culture of accuracy, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.



What Success Looks Like

• All assigned next-day loads are reviewed and verified before pickup.

• QA associates consistently complete required verification steps accurately and on time.

• Driver information, CDL verification, tracking assignments, and check calls are properly documented.

• Potential freight fraud indicators are identified early and escalated immediately.

• High-risk or unresolved verification issues are not overlooked or allowed to progress without appropriate action.

• Workloads are distributed fairly and effectively, and the team consistently meets operational deadlines.

• Individual performance is monitored, and recurring errors are addressed through coaching and accountability.

• Carrier Sales, Operations, and Management have clear visibility into verification progress and outstanding concerns.

• Shift handovers are organized, with no critical tasks left without ownership.

• QA processes become more consistent, efficient, and reliable under your leadership.



Who We're Looking For

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience in a US freight brokerage, trucking carrier, or third-party logistics (3PL) company, preferably in Track & Trace, carrier operations, dispatch, or logistics quality assurance.

• Previous experience as a Team Lead, Senior QA Associate, Operations Supervisor, or similar leadership role is strongly preferred.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, including driver assignments, pickup and delivery appointments, equipment requirements, and CDL verification.

• Familiarity with freight fraud prevention, carrier verification, and operational risk management.

• Experience using Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and GPS tracking platforms such as FourKites, Samsara, or MacroPoint.

• Proven ability to manage workloads, monitor team performance, and maintain operational accountability.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to make decisions under pressure.

• Ability to investigate conflicting information, identify operational risks, and determine appropriate escalation actions.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including confidence communicating with US-based drivers, dispatchers, and operational leadership.

• Comfortable handling outbound calls, difficult conversations, and urgent operational escalations.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to coach team members, provide constructive feedback, and address performance concerns professionally.

• High attention to detail, strong ownership, and a proactive approach to operational challenges.

• Minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Work Setup & Schedule

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Schedule: Sunday - Thursday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time | Tuesday - Saturday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, backup internet and power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Leadership Experience: Take ownership of team performance, operational quality, and daily execution.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help prevent freight fraud, protect shipments, improve operational accuracy, and strengthen team performance.

• Structured Workflows: Established SOPs, clear expectations, and opportunities to contribute to process improvements.



Ready to Apply?



Freight fraud prevention and operational accuracy are critical to the success of our business. We're looking for a leader who can do more than supervise a team, someone who can take ownership, make sound decisions, hold people accountable, and ensure every verification is completed correctly.



If you're an experienced US logistics professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex operational problems, and knows how to lead a team toward consistent results, we'd like to hear from you.

We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

title: Real Estate Lending Lead Qualifier – Outbound Calls & Texts (GoHighLevel) – PH Night Shift
description:
⚡ Warm leads only, no cold calling · 🕐 1–9 AM PHT, Mon–Fri · 💵 Guaranteed weekly base pay + bonuses



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📞 ABOUT THE ROLE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

We run
 ads for US real estate investors who need gap funding (closing reserves). Most of them are closing on a deal within days, so speed matters.



When a new lead comes in, you call them within 15 minutes, have a friendly 5-minute conversation, check 4 quick items, log them in GoHighLevel, and help qualified leads submit our lending partner's application.



👉 This is NOT a sales or closing role. Our lending partner's team handles everything after the application. You are the fast, friendly first contact.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕐 SCHEDULE

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday–Friday

   (1:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine Time; becomes 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT when US daylight saving time starts in March)

• No weekends and no US holidays

• Each shift starts with a short queue of overnight leads, then you handle new leads as they arrive

• You must respond to GoHighLevel alerts within 15 minutes during your shift



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅ WHAT YOU WILL DO

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Call new leads within 15 minutes of an alert

▸ Ask 4 quick questions: how soon and how much funding they need, their annual income, their estimated credit score, and whether anything on their credit might cause a lender to say no

▸ Rate each lead's interest as Hot, Warm, or Cold

▸ Send the application link to qualified leads and help Hot leads submit it during the call

▸ Explain next-step options to leads who don't qualify yet

▸ Update contact fields, tags, and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel after every call

▸ Leave voi
s, send follow-up texts, and log every attempt

▸ Follow a simple script and SOP (we will train you)



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 REQUIREMENTS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ Clear, confident spoken English that US callers understand easily

✔ Experience making outbound calls to US contacts (real estate, lending, insurance, or similar preferred)

✔ GoHighLevel or LeadConnector experience strongly preferred

✔ Comfortable asking about income and credit in a warm, respectful way

✔ Stable internet (fiber preferred) PLUS backup internet and backup power for brownouts

✔ Quiet workspace, noise-canceling headset, and a smartphone for the GHL app

✔ Reliable and responsive: missing alerts is the #1 reason this role would not work out



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💵 PAY (USD)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• Guaranteed base: $75/week, paid weekly

• $2.50 per completed qualification call (all 4 items logged, call recorded)

• $12.50 bonus each time a lead you qualified submits the application



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📈 ABOUT LEAD VOLUME

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Our
 ad campaign launched recently and is in its learning phase on a starting budget. We currently average about 5 leads per day, arriving at random times. To start, your day will be:

• Following up on overnight leads at the start of your shift

• Staying on call for new leads and calling each one within 15 minutes



We plan to increase our ad spend over the coming weeks, which should increase daily lead volume and your performance pay. Your base pay stays the same no matter how many leads come in.



💡 Estimated total at current volume: about $500–750/month. This should grow as volume increases, but we can't guarantee a specific amount.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📝 HOW TO APPLY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Start your application with the words "GAP FUNDING" so we know you read this post. Then answer:



1️⃣ Do you have experience with GoHighLevel or LeadConnector? Explain how you would update custom fields and move a lead from "New" to "Pre-Qualified."



2️⃣ CONTEXT: You are the first person to call a new lead. Your goal is a quick, friendly 5-minute call to learn 4 things: how soon and how much funding they need, their annual income, their estimated credit score, and whether anything on their credit report might cause a lender to say no.



Our lending partner declines applicants for one of these reasons:

• Credit score is below 650

• Too many late payments or derogatory marks on their credit report

• Income isn't high enough to support the funding (funding is typically sized at about 40% of annual income)



Applicants who don't qualify yet have two options to get back in position:

• Credit repair: clean up the credit report and raise the score, then reapply.

• Credit sponsor: bring on someone with strong credit and income to apply alongside them.



You do not approve or reject anyone. Your questions help us spot these issues early, so leads don't waste time on an application that gets declined and know their options instead.



SCENARIO: An investor answers and says: "I'm closing in 3 days and need funding fast. My credit is around 610." When you ask whether anything on their credit report might come up, they get quiet and say, "Why do you need to know that?"



Write exactly what you would say next.



3️⃣ Record a 30–45 second Loom video or Vocaroo audio. Introduce yourself, describe your US phone outreach experience, and confirm you can work 10 AM – 6 PM US Mountain Time (1 AM – 9 AM Philippine Time). Include your link.



4️⃣ Paste your internet speed test result (speedtest.net link) and describe your backup plan for internet and power outages.



⚠️ Applications without "GAP FUNDING" or without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: BIM Modeller / Scan-to-BIM Specialist
description:
About 3D Walkabout



3D Walkabout is an Australian 3D scanning and digital modelling company delivering high-quality scan-to-BIM, as-built documentation, CAD, 3D modelling, and digital twin solutions for clients across construction, architecture, engineering, manufacturing, renovation, and fabrication.



We work on a wide variety of projects, including building renovations, as-built surveys, product modelling, fabrication support, architectural documentation, and modelling from point clouds, 2D drawings, and drone imagery.



We are looking for a skilled BIM Modeller / Scan-to-BIM Specialist based in the Philippines to join our remote production team.



About the Role



You will be responsible for converting 3D scan data and point clouds into accurate BIM, CAD, and 3D model outputs. This role is ideal for someone with strong Revit, point cloud, CAD, and modelling experience who understands scan-to-BIM workflows and can work independently with Australian project requirements.



You may also assist with coordinating and quality-checking work produced by our existing offshore scan-to-BIM production partner in India.



Key Responsibilities



Your work may include:

- Scan-to-BIM modelling up to LOD 400

- Converting E57 point clouds to BIM / RVT

- Processing and cleaning point cloud data

- Converting E57 to RCP / ReCap

- Creating 2D DWG CAD drawings from E57 point clouds, including furniture and MEP elements

- Creating 3D models from 2D drawings

- Supporting as-built modelling for buildings, renovations, and fabrication projects

- Product and object modelling from scan data

- Photogrammetry and modelling from drone aerial imagery

- Reviewing and quality-checking BIM/CAD outputs from external production teams

- Coordinating modelling tasks with overseas production partners when required

- Maintaining high accuracy, clean file structure, and consistent modelling standards



Experience with point cloud data from any of the following scanners is highly regarded:

- Matterport Pro3

- Einscan Rigil

- Leica BLK360

- Trimble X7



You do not need to have operated all of these scanners, but you should be comfortable working with point cloud files and scan-based modelling workflows.



Required Skills and Experience



The ideal candidate will have:

- Strong experience in Autodesk Revit

- Experience with scan-to-BIM workflows

- Ability to work from E57, RCP, RCS, ASC, DWG, and RVT files

- Experience creating accurate as-built models from point clouds

- Good understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP modelling

- Ability to produce clean and accurate 2D CAD drawings

- Experience with Autodesk ReCap or similar point cloud processing software

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Ability to follow modelling standards and project instructions

- Good written English communication skills

- Ability to work remotely and manage deadlines independently





The following skills would be a strong advantage:

- Experience with LOD 300 to LOD 400 BIM modelling

- Experience managing or checking work from other BIM modellers

- Experience with offshore BIM production coordination

- Experience with fabrication modelling

- Experience converting ASC to STP / STEP

- Experience with mesh cleanup, reverse engineering, or product modelling

- Experience with drone photogrammetry workflows

- Experience with Navisworks, AutoCAD, Rhino, SolidWorks, Cyclone, CloudCompare, or similar tools



We are looking for someone who is:

- Accurate and detail-oriented

- Reliable and deadline-focused

- Comfortable working with point cloud data

- Able to solve modelling problems independently

- Good at communicating progress and raising issues early

- Interested in long-term remote work with an Australian company

- Capable of reviewing and managing work from other production teams over time

- Working Arrangement

- Remote role based in the Philippines

- Work with an Australian team

- Full-time preferred, but strong part-time or contract candidates may be considered

- Long-term opportunity for the right person



Please send us:

- Your CV or resume

- Examples of scan-to-BIM, Revit, CAD, or point cloud projects you have completed

- A short description of your experience with point cloud modelling

- Your software experience

- Your availability and expected monthly salary or hourly rate



Please include the subject line:

Application – Remote BIM Modeller Philippines

description:
Video Editor & Social Media Manager



We are looking for a creative, proactive and experienced Video Editor & Social Media Manager to join our digital marketing team, working across two established New Zealand businesses in the Immigration and Mortgage Advisory industries.

The ideal candidate should have strong video editing, graphic design, AI content creation and social media management skills. You must be comfortable working with scripts, maintaining brand consistency and independently managing content from production through to publishing.



Key Responsibilities



Video Editing, Scripts & AI Content Creation



• Edit engaging short-form and long-form videos for YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.

• Work closely with our Content Writer and SEO Manager to review scripts, improve video flow and develop engaging visual storytelling.

• Add accurate timestamps, chapters, subtitles, captions and on-screen text to videos wherever appropriate.

• Match video footage, B-roll, animations and graphics with the script to deliver a professional final product.

• Use AI-powered tools such as Higgsfield AI, ChatGPT, Claude, CapCut AI and other creative AI platforms to improve video production and content quality.

• Repurpose long-form videos into Shorts, Reels and other platform-specific content.

• Create engaging thumbnails, hooks, transitions and motion graphics.



Social Media Management & Publishing



• Manage content creation, scheduling and publishing across YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.

• Prepare and optimise captions, descriptions, hashtags, video titles, timestamps and YouTube chapters.

• Maintain each business's brand voice, professional tone, messaging and visual identity across all published content.

• Adapt posts to suit each platform while maintaining consistent brand messaging.

• Maintain an organised content calendar and ensure timely publishing.

• Monitor performance, engagement and audience growth, and suggest improvements.

• Ensure all content is reviewed and approved before publishing when required.



Graphic Design & Canva



• Create high-quality social media graphics, carousels, thumbnails, banners and promotional materials.

• Demonstrate excellent Canva skills, including brand templates, typography, layouts and visual consistency.

• Use AI image generation and design tools to produce creative, professional visuals.

• Ensure graphics and videos meet the branding requirements of both businesses.



Teamwork & Content Coordination



• Collaborate with the Content Writer and SEO Manager to turn blogs, scripts and website content into engaging videos and social media posts.

• Assist with script formatting, visual planning and content repurposing.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity without compromising content accuracy or quality.

• Proactively recommend creative ideas, emerging AI tools and new content formats.

• Take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate progress regularly and meet deadlines.



Requirements



• Proven experience in video editing, social media management and graphic design.

• Strong skills in Canva and editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

• Practical experience using AI tools for video generation, editing, graphic design, script enhancement and content creation.

• Experience with Higgsfield AI or similar AI video platforms is highly desirable.

• Ability to work from scripts and accurately insert video timestamps, subtitles and YouTube chapters.

• Experience creating and publishing content across YouTube,
, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.

• Strong understanding of brand tone, visual identity, social media optimisation and audience engagement.

• Good written English, creativity and attention to detail.

• Proactive communication, honesty, responsiveness, reliability and teamwork are essential.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple content deadlines.



What We Offer



• USD $5 per hour

• Remote working opportunity.

• Part-time or full-time role depending on experience and availability.

• Long-term opportunity with two growing New Zealand businesses.

• Collaborative environment working alongside our Content Writer and SEO Manager.

• Opportunity to experiment with emerging AI creative tools.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your updated CV.

2. A portfolio of your best video editing and graphic design work.

3. Links to YouTube channels or social media accounts you have managed.

4. Details of the AI tools you regularly use, particularly Higgsfield AI and other AI video creation platforms.

5. Examples of videos you have edited from scripts, including captions, timestamps or chapters.

6. A brief explanation of how your content helped previous businesses improve audience engagement, social media growth or lead generation.

7. Your location and availability (part-time or full-time).



Application Subject Line: Video Editor & Social Media Manager – [Your City]



We are looking for someone who is creative, dependable, detail-oriented and takes genuine ownership of their work, rather than someone who simply edits videos and schedules posts.

title: Travel Consultant (Sabre)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and organised Travel Consultant to provide comprehensive travel planning, booking, and administrative support.



The successful candidate will be responsible for researching and preparing travel quotations, creating detailed itineraries, comparing flights and accommodation options, coordinating transfers and cruise arrangements, and handling travel-related documentation and financial administration.



This role requires someone with a strong understanding of the travel industry, experience using GDS and CRM platforms, and the ability to manage multiple travel arrangements while maintaining accuracy and excellent attention to detail.



Key Responsibilities



1. Travel Research & Booking



Research and prepare flight quotations using GDS platforms, particularly Sabre.

Source and compare hotel accommodation options based on specific client requirements.

Obtain and compare airport transfer and ground transportation quotations.

Research and prepare cruise quotations when required.

Research travel insurance options and compare policy coverage, including existing and preferred providers.

Ensure all travel options meet the client's specific requirements and preferences.

2. Travel Itinerary Management



Create and update detailed travel itineraries using an itinerary builder.

Organise flight, hotel, transfer, cruise, and other travel arrangements.

Ensure all itinerary information, dates, prices, and booking details are accurate.

Double-check travel arrangements and documentation before submission.

3. CRM & Travel Systems Management



Manage client and booking information using the ResWorld CRM.

Use GDS platforms, particularly Sabre, for flight research and booking support.

Maintain accurate and updated client records and travel information.

Follow established workflows and procedures for managing travel requests and bookings.

4. Administrative & Financial Support



Prepare, organise, and manage receipts and invoices.

Convert documents into PDF format and edit files when necessary.

Maintain and update accounts payable and accounts receivable spreadsheets.

Balance and reconcile payable and receivable records before submission.

Organise financial documents and supporting records.

Double-check figures, receipts, invoices, and financial documentation for accuracy.

5. General Administrative Support



Maintain organised digital files and travel documentation.

Keep client information, booking records, and workflows updated.

Assist with other administrative tasks related to travel operations.

Ensure tasks are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.

Qualifications & Requirements



Previous experience as a Travel Consultant, Travel Agent, or in a similar travel industry role.

Experience using GDS platforms, particularly Sabre.

Familiarity with travel CRM systems, preferably ResWorld.

Experience preparing travel itineraries and travel quotations.

Knowledge of flights, hotels, airport transfers, cruises, and travel insurance.

Experience researching and comparing travel insurance policies.

Basic bookkeeping or financial administration experience.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

Experience using Microsoft Authenticator for multi-factor authentication (MFA) and secure access to work accounts.

Experience converting, editing, and organising PDF documents.

Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet deadlines.

Tools & Systems



The successful candidate should be familiar with or have experience using:



Sabre GDS

ResWorld CRM

Travel itinerary builder platforms

Microsoft Authenticator

Microsoft Office (particularly Excel)

Google Workspace (particularly Google Sheets)

PDF editing and document management tools

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is an experienced Travel Consultant who is proactive, resourceful, and highly organised. They should have a strong understanding of travel arrangements and booking processes, be confident researching and comparing travel options, and have excellent administrative and financial documentation skills.



They must be comfortable handling sensitive client and financial information, following established workflows, and managing multiple responsibilities with minimal supervision.



Someone who has previously supported a travel agency, travel consultant, or independent travel professional would be an excellent fit.

title: Senior Kaseya Specialist - Part-Time Remote
description:
Company: AirNetworks, LLC (San Antonio, Texas based MSP)



Hours: Part-time, approximately 20 to 25 hours per week



Schedule: Monday to Friday, covering US Central Time business hours. Typical window is 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM CST (which is 11:00 PM to 4:00 AM Philippines time, overnight shift). Exact hours flexible within that window. Candidates must be comfortable with overnight work schedule.



Salary: $500 to $700 USD per month depending on experience



About us



AirNetworks is a Managed Service Provider based in San Antonio, Texas, serving clients in healthcare, legal, government, and business sectors across Texas. We are expanding our team with a Kaseya specialist to support a white-label engagement with an MSP partner that has invested in the Kaseya stack but needs expert deployment and ongoing operational leadership.



This is a senior role. We are looking for an engineer who already carries deep operational expertise with Kaseya, not someone looking to learn the platform on the job.



What you will do



Deploy and configure the Kaseya stack from scratch for an MSP partner that has purchased licenses but has not yet implemented them.



Design the architecture for multi-tenant Kaseya operations, including VSA, BMS (or Vorex), IT Glue, Datto RMM, Datto backup, Rapidfire Tools, Graphus, Dark Web ID, and other Kaseya modules the partner has licensed.



Build automation scripts, agent procedures, monitoring policies, patching schedules, and alerting workflows that scale across the partner’s full client base.



Integrate Kaseya with other critical platforms including PSA workflows, remote access tools, documentation systems, and ticketing.



Document all configurations, procedures, and runbooks to establish operational standards for the partner MSP.



Mentor and support junior technicians on Kaseya best practices.



Serve as escalation point for complex issues that exceed Level 1 and Level 2 technician capabilities.



Lead client onboarding processes from the Kaseya side: agent deployment, discovery, inventory, baseline compliance, and monitoring setup.



Troubleshoot complex Kaseya platform issues, including agent connectivity, policy inheritance, automation failures, integration problems, and performance optimization.



Participate in planning sessions for expansion of the Kaseya practice as the partner grows.



Must have qualifications



Minimum 7 years hands-on experience architecting and operating the full Kaseya stack in production MSP environments supporting 500 or more endpoints across multiple client tenants.



You must have led, as the primary engineer, at least two greenfield Kaseya VSA or Datto RMM deployments from procurement through production. This includes multi-tenant architecture design, discovery and inventory, patch management policy, automation agent procedure library, monitoring policy design, alerting workflow, and integration with PSA and documentation platforms.



Deep expertise with at least four of the following: Kaseya VSA, Kaseya BMS, Vorex, IT Glue, Datto RMM, Datto SIRIS/ALTO backup, Rapidfire Tools, Graphus, Spanning, Dark Web ID.



Strong scripting skills in PowerShell and preferably Python for automation of Kaseya agent procedures and workflows. You should have a portfolio of automations you personally built.



Deep understanding of MSP operations: multi-tenant architecture, SLA management, client onboarding, change management, i
 management.



Experience mentoring and developing junior technicians.



Business level English, both written and spoken. You will lead client-facing technical discussions and documentation.



Strong documentation discipline.



Ability to work independently and manage priorities across multiple initiatives.



Ability to consistently work overnight hours in Philippines (approximately 11:00 PM to 4:00 AM PHT) covering US Central Time business hours.



Reliable high-speed internet connection at your workstation.



Quiet workspace suitable for client calls and screen sharing sessions.



Preferred qualifications



Kaseya certifications (VSA Certified Administrator, BMS/Vorex Certified, IT Glue Certified, Datto certifications).



Experience with migrations from ConnectWise, N-able, Atera, NinjaOne, or Autotask to Kaseya.



Previous Level 3 or Technical Lead role in an MSP.



Exposure to regulated verticals (HIPAA, PCI, government compliance).



Microsoft 365 administration and Intune management.



Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy proficiency.



Experience building MSP service catalogs and operational playbooks.



Expectations for this role



This is not an entry-level position and is not a learning role. We expect you to arrive with deep Kaseya expertise already in place and to function as the subject matter expert on the platform from week one.



During your first 30 days you will be expected to:



Audit the current Kaseya license inventory and deployment status for the partner MSP.



Propose a deployment roadmap with timelines and dependencies.



Begin configuration of foundational modules.



Document your architectural decisions and present them to leadership.



Candidates who need significant ramp-up time to become productive on Kaseya should not apply.



What we offer



Stable part-time remote work with a growing MSP.



Monthly salary paid on time via direct transfer.



Collaborative team environment with engineers in Mexico and the US.



Opportunity to contribute to building a specialized Kaseya practice from the ground up.



What we are NOT looking for



Please do not apply if:



Your Kaseya experience is limited to being an end user of VSA from the client side.



You have only used Kaseya in a single tenant corporate IT environment without MSP multi-client exposure.



Your Kaseya experience is limited to using the platform to open tickets or run scripts someone else built, without having designed or operated the platform itself.



You are looking for a role with no client-facing responsibilities (this role requires direct communication with the partner MSP’s leadership and technicians).



You are not comfortable owning a technical practice from the ground up.



You cannot commit to the overnight Philippines schedule (11:00 PM to 4:00 AM PHT) that covers US business hours.



Your English is not comfortable for leading client technical discussions.



How to apply



Please send your application including your updated CV and brief answers to these six questions to 
 in detail the largest Kaseya VSA or Datto RMM environment you have personally architected and operated. Include: total endpoint count, number of client tenants, specific modules deployed (VSA, BMS/Vorex, IT Glue, Datto RMM, Datto backup, Graphus, Rapidfire, Dark Web ID), the automation library you built (number of agent procedures, specific examples), integrations you configured, and three specific operational problems you solved that required deep platform knowledge rather than vendor support tickets.

Which Kaseya modules do you consider your deepest expertise, and which modules would be a learning curve for you?

Describe a specific automation you built using Kaseya agent procedures or scripting that delivered measurable operational improvement. Include the problem, your solution approach, the code or logic involved, and the result.

Rate your English level for professional technical discussions with US clients. Describe a situation where you led a technical discovery or design discussion in English.

Confirm your availability to work overnight hours in Philippines (approximately 11:00 PM to 4:00 AM PHT), covering US Central Time business hours, for 20 to 25 hours per week on a consistent basis.

Walk us through how you would troubleshoot a Kaseya VSA agent that shows online in the dashboard but fails to execute any agent procedures. Include which logs you would check, in what order, and what the three most likely root causes typically are. Answer from memory without googling.



Applications without answers to all six questions will not be reviewed.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
Company: Servicify – Construction & Maintenance Solutions

Position: Full-Time

Industry: Construction & Building Maintenance



About Us



Servicify is an Australian construction and maintenance company based in Brisbane, Queensland, operating across Brisbane, the Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast.



With over 10 years of industry experience, we specialise in painting, rope access, building maintenance and a wide range of construction services.



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team remotely and assist with preparing accurate quotations and tenders for residential, commercial and industrial projects.



Our main focus is painting, plastering and rope access, along with other construction and maintenance services.



Key Responsibilities



Review Australian construction drawings, specifications and tender documents.



Perform accurate quantity takeoffs and measurements.



Calculate labour, materials and equipment costs.



Prepare detailed quotations and tender submissions.



Identify inclusions, exclusions and potential project risks.



Obtain supplier and subcontractor pricing when required.



Maintain estimating spreadsheets and cost databases.



Coordinate with our Australian team to finalise quotes.



Ensure tenders are completed accurately and on time.



Requirements



Previous experience in construction estimating or quantity surveying.



Experience estimating painting and/or plastering projects.



Ability to interpret Australian construction drawings.



Proficiency in Excel and estimating software such as Bluebeam, CostX, PlanSwift or Groundplan



Good written and spoken English.



Strong attention to detail and time management skills.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment.



Highly Regarded:



Previous experience with Australian construction companies.



Experience estimating rope access, façade maintenance or high-rise projects.



Knowledge of Australian construction materials and estimating practices.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience.



Full-time remote working arrangement.



Long-term career opportunity.



Training and support from our Brisbane-based team.



Opportunity to work across multiple construction and maintenance services.



How to Apply



Please provide your CV, relevant estimating experience, software proficiency, examples of previous takeoffs or estimates (with confidential information removed), expected monthly salary in AUD and availability to commence.



Servicify

Construction & Maintenance Solutions

Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

title: Ecommerce Specialist (Shopify, SEO & Paid Media)
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



E-Commerce Specialist (Shopify, SEO & Paid Media)



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break



Job Overview:

The E-commerce Specialist executes and optimizes the DTC eCommerce channel, supporting revenue growth across Shopify, organic search (SEO), and paid media (Google Ads). This role partners closely with the E-commerce Manager to translate strategy into results, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve traffic, conversion rates, and customer lifetime value.



The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on execution with a focus on Shopify optimization, SEO growth, technical website improvements, and paid media performance (Google Ads), contributing to revenue growth and overall eCommerce performance. The candidate should also be capable of independently troubleshooting website issues, implementing technical improvements, following direction, and consistently delivering assigned tasks.



Key Responsibilities:

Shopify Store Management & Product Operations

* Build and maintain product pages, collections, and landing pages optimized for conversion and SEO.

* Manage and optimize Shopify apps to improve site functionality and user experience.



Merchandising & Conversion Optimization (CRO)

* Execute merchandising strategies to promote key products, collections, and campaigns.

* Build and update promotional and campaign landing pages.

* Monitor site performance, troubleshoot issues, and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

* Implement website improvements that enhance user experience, site functionality, and overall conversion performance.



SEO & Organic Growth

* Collaborate on SEO strategy to increase market share and drive sustained growth in high-intent organic traffic and conversion rates.

* Define and execute keyword strategy, on-page optimization, and content initiatives aligned with business and revenue goals.

* Own optimization of product listings, category structures, and landing pages to maximize search visibility and performance.

* Optimize product listings, collections, and landing pages for search visibility.

* Monitor SEO performance metrics and continuously identify opportunities to improve traffic quality, rankings, and conversions.

* Implement SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies to improve visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

* Leverage AI tools and technologies to identify optimization opportunities, improve search visibility, drive organic traffic, and support revenue growth.

* Apply technical SEO best practices, including website structure, metadata, indexing, and page performance optimization.



Website Development & Technical Optimization

* Use HTML and CSS to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve website issues independently.

* Implement technical website improvements to enhance functionality, usability, and overall site performance.

* Identify and address website issues that may affect search visibility, user experience, and conversion rates.

* Collaborate with the E-commerce Manager to implement technical updates and website enhancements as needed.



Paid Media (Google Ads)

* Support Google Ads campaigns (Search, Shopping, and Display).

* Assist with keyword research, campaign setup, and bid optimization.

* Monitor performance metrics such as ROAS, CPC, and conversions.

* Collaborate on testing ad creatives and landing pages to improve performance.



Analytics & Reporting

* Track performance across Shopify, Google Analytics, SEO, and paid media channels.

* Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for growth.

* Provide regular updates and insights to the E-commerce Manager.



General Support

* Execute tasks based on direction and SOPs.

* Collaborate with design, marketing, and customer service teams.

* Support additional eCommerce initiatives and ad hoc projects as needed.

* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities, follow instructions accurately, and work independently while maintaining * consistent communication with the team.

* Maintain reliable attendance, adhere to agreed working hours, and consistently meet deadlines and deliverables.



Qualifications

* 3–5+ years of experience in an eCommerce or DTC environment.

* Hands-on experience with Shopify (product management, collections, landing pages, apps).

* Working knowledge of SEO best practices (on-page optimization, keyword usage, basic technical SEO).

* Experience with SEO, AEO, and GEO optimization, including familiarity with AI-powered search and AI-assisted optimization tools.

* Proficiency in HTML and CSS, with the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve website issues.

* Experience implementing website improvements and technical optimizations that support site performance, user experience, and conversion rates.

* Experience with Google Ads (Search and/or Shopping preferred).

* Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar analytics tools.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to execute accurately.

* Organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong communication skills and ability to follow direction.

* Ability to work independently, demonstrate accountability, and consistently meet working hours and deliverables.

* Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and improve.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Amazon FBA Product Sourcer
description:
**About Us:**

We run a growing Amazon FBA business focused mostly on online arbitrage and some wholesale. We're looking for a detail-oriented, self-motivated sourcing specialist who can find profitable products and help scale our operations.



**Training & Development:**

You will be personally trained where you will learn everything you need to know, including our specific product criteria, sourcing strategies, and systems. This is a structured training program designed to set you up for success.



Selection Process:

The top 3 applicants will be selected for training. After the training period, the best performing candidate will be chosen for the permanent position on our team.



**Your Role:**

You'll be responsible for finding profitable products through online arbitrage and wholesale sourcing, analyzing deals, and managing supplier relationships. This is a critical role that directly impacts our profitability.



**Key Responsibilities:**

- Source profitable products using online arbitrage methods (retail websites, clearance sections, daily deals)

- Research and develop wholesale supplier relationships

- Analyze products using tools like Keepa, and SellerAmp

- Verify product profitability, competition, and sales history

- Maintain organized spreadsheets with sourcing data using google sheets

- Monitor existing products for restock opportunities

- Stay updated on Amazon policy changes and restricted brands



**Required Skills & Experience:**

- Minimum 1 year of Amazon OA/wholesale sourcing experience (required)

- Proficient with sourcing tools (Keepa, RevSeller, SellerAmp, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar)

- Strong understanding of Amazon FBA fees, profit calculations, and ROI

- Knowledge of IP complaints, gating, and restricted categories

- Excellent attention to detail and data organization



If you have read this far, please add the word "pineapple" in the subject line of your application.



- Self-motivated with ability to work independently

- Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)

- Reliable internet connection and computer

- Familiarity with Microsoft Teams (our primary communication platform)

- Must be comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking software



**Compensation Structure:**

- **Regular Position:** $2.00/hour flat rate and a pay per lead structure

-This payment structure was preferred by our current sourcing VAs as this incentivizes hard work and the ability to earn more than just an hourly rate

- Long-term growth opportunity with our expanding business



**Work Schedule & Time Tracking:**

- Full-time position: Monday - Friday, 8 hours per day

- Consistent schedule required

- Communication via Microsoft Teams throughout the workday

- **Time tracking via Hubstaff software (required)** - This software tracks hours worked and takes random screenshots throughout the work day to ensure productivity and accountability



---



**APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (MUST COMPLETE ALL):**



**1. Subject Line Format:**

"Amazon Sourcing VA - [Your First Name] - [Years of Experience]"



**2. Answer These Questions:**

- What sourcing tools are you most proficient with and why?

- Describe your typical process for vetting a product's profitability

- What's your average daily product find rate (approved products)?

- What was your best find in the last 3 months? (Include ROI and monthly sales velocity)

- What's one common mistake new sourcing VAs make?



**3. Technical Requirements:**

- Take a screenshot of your internet speed test from **https://www.speedtest.net** and include it in your application

- Complete the English proficiency test at ** ---------- ** and include your score/results



---



**APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS EXACTLY WILL BE IMMEDIATELY DISQUALIFIED.**



We value attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely - these are essential skills for success in this role. We're looking for someone who can start immediately, is eager to learn our specific systems, and wants to grow with our business long-term.



If you're a dedicated sourcer who takes pride in finding great deals and following processes, we want to hear from you!

title: Full-Time DTC Video Editor – Skincare Brand | $5–$6/Hour + Up to $1,000 Per Winning Video
description:
We are looking for a full-time DTC Video Editor to join our growing skincare brand.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make beautiful-looking videos.



We care about one thing above everything else:



Does the creative make people stop, watch, and buy?



A simple video that converts is far more valuable to us than a cinematic edit that doesn’t generate sales.



You need to understand direct-response creative structure: hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, offers, CTAs, and why people keep watching or scroll away.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, take ownership of their work, continuously improve, and grow with us long term.





Compensation & Bonuses:



Base pay is $5–$6 per hour, depending on your experience and skill level.



But your base salary is only one part of your earning potential.



We have a strong performance-based bonus system where editors can earn up to $1,000 from a single winning video.



In strong months, there is potential to earn 3–5x your base salary through performance bonuses.



When the brand performs better, we all make more money together.



We also offer:



- Performance bonuses for winning creatives

- Annual tenure / loyalty bonuses

- Additional performance-based rewards

- Opportunities for higher compensation as you grow with the company



We want the people who help us grow to benefit from that growth as well.





What You’ll Be Doing:



You will be creating English-language direct-response video ads for a skincare DTC brand.



Your job will include:



- Editing performance-focused DTC creatives

- Turning scripts, concepts, footage, UGC, B-roll, and AI-generated content into finished ads

- Creating strong hooks that stop the scroll

- Creating and integrating AI-generated video scenes

- Improving creatives based on feedback and performance

- Continuously learning what makes an ad convert



We don’t expect every creative to look like a movie.



We expect you to understand why an ad works.





What We’re Looking For:



Previous experience creating video ads for DTC / Shopify brands is REQUIRED.



Please do not apply if you have only edited YouTube videos, wedding videos, gaming videos, corporate videos, or traditional social media content without direct-response e-commerce experience.



You should:



- Have experience editing DTC performance creatives
