title: Senior AI Ecommerce Designer, Amazon Listings and Ads
description:
ABOUT US



We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners like Petco and Costco. We are looking for a Senior AI Ecommerce Designer to own the images that sell those products.



Your work d
 whether a shopper clicks and whether they buy. You will design Amazon and Chewy listing images, A+ Content, Brand Stories, storefronts, marketplace assets, Amazon ad creative, and landing pages. We measure your work by click-through rate and conversion rate, not by how it looks in a portfolio.



This role is for a designer who already uses AI every day. You will combine Photoshop and Illustrator with generative AI tools to concept, stage, and composite photorealistic product images in hours, not weeks. We need speed and volume, but neither is an excuse for generic work.



Pay: USD 1,500-2,000 per month

Schedule: US PST

Reports to: Creative Director, who sets weekly priorities. You will work closely with our Video Editor, Social Media Manager, and brand managers.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF



AI is not already part of your daily design workflow. This is a requirement.

Your work depends on templates, Canva layouts, or stock mockups.

You submit raw AI generations without retouching and compositing.

You need a week to deliver what a strong AI workflow can deliver in a day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Marketplace Assets



Design Amazon main images that follow Amazon’s white background and product fill rules while standing out in search results.

Build full secondary image sets: benefit infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, materials and ingredient visuals, lifestyle scenes, and in-use images.

Design Premium A+ and standard A+ modules, Brand Story carousels, and Brand Storefront pages.

Create Chewy listing images and rich content to Chewy’s specs.

Adapt assets for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and retail partner requirements.

Design mobile-first. Every image must read clearly at thumbnail size on a phone.

Deliver multiple variations of main images and A+ Content for split testing, and use the results to shape the next round.

Audit and refresh underperforming listings using click-through and conversion data from the brand managers.



Amazon Ads and Landing Pages



Design Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, Amazon Posts, and seasonal, deal, and promo graphics.

Deliver ad variations for testing and refresh creative as performance data comes in.

Design landing pages and Shopify product pages as full desktop and mobile mockups, with exported assets ready for our Shopify team to build.

Keep messaging and visuals consistent from ad to listing to landing page.



AI Workflow and Compositing



Use generative AI to explore several creative directions quickly before committing to one.

Generate photorealistic lifestyle scenes (homes, yards, apartments, balconies, pets in real settings) and composite our real products into them with correct lighting, shadows, perspective, scale, and color.

Replace, extend, and clean up backgrounds using Photoshop Generative Fill, Firefly, Flux, or similar tools.

Upscale and enhance images with Magnific or similar tools without adding artifacts.

Fix AI errors before anything ships: pet anatomy, paws, eyes, fur edges, warped geometry, garbled text, and incorrect product details.

Work from any source assets we have (studio photos, supplier images, 3D files, basic product shots) and flag when a reshoot is needed.

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and scene templates to keep output consistent across brands.

Test new AI tools as they launch and recommend the ones that make the team faster or better.



Brand Consistency and Compliance



Keep each brand visually distinct while following its typography, color, and tone guidelines.

Keep products accurate in every image. AI must never change the size, color, texture, components, or packaging of what the customer receives.

Follow Amazon, Chewy, Walmart, and TikTok Shop image and content policies, including rules on claims, badges, and comparisons.

Use only product claims approved by the brand managers.

Use only AI tools and assets licensed for commercial use.

Keep organized, layered source files with clear naming and version control in our shared drive.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Design Fundamentals



4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with at least 2 years designing Amazon listing images and A+ Content.

Expert-level Photoshop and Illustrator, including advanced masking, color matching, compositing, and high-end retouching.

Strong typography. You pair fonts with intention, build clear hierarchy, and avoid generic or dated type.

Strong command of layout, grids, color, and visual hierarchy, including desktop and mobile landing pages.

Ability to turn a product benefit into a visual a shopper understands in 3 seconds, without a wall of text.

Working knowledge of what drives marketplace conversion: scannable benefits, objection handling, comparison framing, and image sequence.

Clear written English for on-image copy and daily work with a US-based team.



AI Prompting and Retouching



At least 1 year of daily, hands-on use of generative AI in professional design work.

Fluency with Midjourney, Photoshop Generative Fill and Firefly, Flux, Magnific, or similar tools.

Ability to control AI output: style and image references, inpainting and outpainting, seeds, and pose or composition control.

Ability to composite real products into AI scenes so the final image reads as a real photo.

A trained eye for AI artifacts and the retouching skill to fix them.

Ability to explain your workflow step by step and how much time AI saves you at each stage.



Nice to Have



Pet product or consumer packaged goods experience.

Experience with Amazon split testing (Manage Your Experiments), Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display creative, or reading click-through and conversion data.

3D rendering experience (Blender, KeyShot, or similar).

Basic motion or video skills to support our Video Editor.

Figma experience for templates and design systems.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applications without a portfolio that includes ALL of the following will not be reviewed:



At least 2 complete Amazon listing image sets (main image plus full secondary carousel) that you designed.

At least 1 full A+ or Premium A+ Content project showing the complete module stack.

At least 1 landing page or ecommerce product page design, shown for desktop and mobile.

At least 3 before-and-after AI compositing examples. For each, show the original source photo, the raw AI generation, and your final image, with a short note on tools used and time spent.

Results where available, such as click-through or conversion lift or a split test outcome. If you are under NDA, explain what you changed and why.

Your role on each project: sole designer, lead, or part of a team.



Live Amazon or Chewy product links are welcome. Portfolios built mainly on templates, stock mockups, or unedited AI output will not move forward.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



A link to your portfolio (Google Drive, Behance, or personal site). Make sure the link is set to public.

A short note on which piece in your portfolio you are most proud of and why.

Start your message with the words “SCROLL STOPPER” so we know you read the full post.



Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Copywriter (Personal Brands)
description:
MEET JSM

JustSimply Marketing is a fast-scaling, fully remote agency based in Ontario, Canada. We help personal brands across the US and Canada build, grow and monetize, from content and funnels to launches for info products and high-ticket programs. We've worked with Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.



TEAM VISION

The copy team turns a founder's story into revenue: every funnel, VSL and
 we ship has to sell. Copywriters report to a Marketing Manager inside the Marketing Director's org, with a path toward the Copywriter Team Manager seat.



THE ROLE

You own the words that convert for our personal-brand clients: funnels, landing pages, VSLs, upsells and
 sequences. You research the audience, capture the founder's voice and write copy that gets people to buy.



You report to a Marketing Manager and work daily with the design and funnel teams to get campaigns live fast. When the numbers come in, you own the next draft.



WHO THIS IS FOR

A direct-response writer, not a blogger or caption writer. Every piece you write has a CTA.

Someone who thinks in conversion rate, CPL and revenue.

A researcher who digs into buyers before writing a word.

Someone who wants feedback on deadline, not praise.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Fully remote work.

Write for high-profile personal brands in the US and Canada.

A clear growth path from Copywriter to Copywriter Team Manager and beyond.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy. Your copy goes live, not into a queue.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Write high-converting copy for funnels, landing pages, VSLs, upsells and
 sequences.

Build audience research and buyer personas for each personal brand before drafting.

Match each founder's voice, story and positioning in every asset.

Ship campaigns fast alongside the marketing, design and funnel teams.

Optimize live copy from conversion data: opt-in, sales and application rates.

Run an AI-assisted workflow (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, angles and first drafts, with human judgment on the final.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven direct-response copy for personal brands (coaches, creators, experts).

Strong grasp of funnels, buyer psychology and high-ticket offers.

Tracked results you can show: conversion rates, revenue or verifiable clients, not just samples.

3+ years of direct-response experience [confirm].

Daily AI use in your writing process (Claude, ChatGPT or similar).

Comfortable in Google Docs and GoHighLevel.

Not a fit if you mainly write blogs or captions without CTAs.



RESULTS

Own copy for at least one full client funnel from research to launch within 30 days.

Build a documented voice and persona file for every brand you write for.

Hit every agreed copy deadline for launches and campaigns.

Ship at least one data-driven copy test per active funnel per month.

Show directional conversion lift on a funnel you've optimized by day 90.



LOCATION & SCHEDULE

Fully remote. 6:00 AM–2:00 PM EST (6:00 PM–2:00 AM PHT), Monday to Friday. Launches move fast. You keep pace.



HOW WE WORK

Results over hours. Output is what counts.

Extreme ownership. If it's yours, you own the outcome.

High accountability, low ego. Do what you said.

Growth over perfection. Ship, measure, improve.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through our application form: 



Only completed forms are considered.

title: Insurance Claims Admin
description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** forms.cloud.microsoft/r/E0B7NuXcmy



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance.



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **



Claims Lodgements

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant



Documentation and Information Requests

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system



Claims Administration

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **



- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



You Must Have

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation)

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals.

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

title: Appointment Setter | Financial Education & Coaching | $2,000 Base + Performance Pay
description:
Overview

We’re hiring a dedicated phone appointment setter for a financial education and coaching business.



You’ll work with our sales team to turn webinar registrants, past leads, and follow-up opportunities into qualified consultations with our closer. We’re looking for someone who can build trust, ask good questions, and consistently book people who actually attend.



This is a remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced setter based in the Philippines.



What You’ll Do

• Call and follow up with assigned leads through phone, SMS, and
.

• Reengage past webinar registrants, no-shows, and older leads.

• Help upcoming registrants prepare for and attend the webinar.

• Follow up with attendees who haven’t booked, and offer the replay to people who missed it.

• Qualify prospects using the company’s criteria, understand their goals, and explain the value of a consultation.

• Book and confirm appointments, coordinate reschedules, and follow up with no-shows.

• Keep GoHighLevel updated with accurate notes, outcomes, and next steps.

• Share daily activity and results with the team through Slack.



Who You Are

• An experienced phone setter with evidence of qualified bookings and strong show rates.

• Comfortable with warm leads, older leads, and outbound calling.

• Clear, natural spoken English and strong written communication.

• Confident using GoHighLevel or a similar CRM.

• Strong at discovery, listening, handling objections, and guiding a conversation toward a clear next step.

• Organized, accountable, coachable, and consistent with follow-up.

• Able to keep conversations focused and concise.

• Reliable computer, internet connection, headset, and a quiet calling environment.

• Webinar or coaching-offer experience is a plus.



Work Environment & Support

You’ll have scripts, frameworks, SOPs, and support from leadership and the sales team. We want someone who can use that structure, own their results, and help improve the process.



Working Hours

Full time, approximately 40 hours per week. You must be available to call US-based prospects during appropriate US daytime and evening hours. The exact schedule will be agreed during the interview process.



What Success Looks Like

We’re a performance-based business. We reward efficiency, skill, and consistent results.



• The standard activity expectation is 100+ dials per day, with at least 6 qualified, setter-generated appointments booked per week.

• If you consistently book 8–10 qualified appointments per week, you can achieve that with fewer dials. Strong results earn flexibility on call volume.

• Maintain a 75%+ show rate. Appointment quality and attendance matter alongside bookings.

• Prospects understand the consultation and meet our qualification criteria before booking.

• Keep accurate CRM records, report daily, and follow through consistently.

• Reschedules, duplicate bookings, and test appointments are not counted as new production.



Compensation (USD)

• Base: $2,000 per month.

• Qualified held appointment: $45 when a qualified prospect you personally generated attends their consultation.

• Closed-client bonus: $150 when one of your appointments becomes a paying client.



Monthly Production Bonus

At a show rate of 75% or higher:

• 20+ setter-generated bookings: $500.

• 25+ bookings: $1,000.

• 30+ bookings: $1,500.

• 35+ bookings: $2,250.

• 40+ bookings: $3,000.



Only the highest achieved monthly tier is paid. Bonuses do not stack. Independently self-booked webinar calls do not count toward setter production.



Example: 40 setter-generated bookings, 30 qualified held calls, and 9 resulting paying clients would total $7,700 for the month. This is a performance illustration, not guaranteed earnings. Actual pay depends on qualified attendance and closed clients.



The initial plan includes a 90-day review of performance, lead volume, targets, and compensation.



How to Apply

Please include:

• Your resume and a brief summary of your appointment-setting experience.

• The types of offers and leads you’ve worked with, plus the CRM tools you’ve used.

• Your recent dials, bookings, and show-rate results, including the period measured and your personal contribution.

• A short Loom introduction explaining why you’re a fit for this role.

• A call recording or role-play sample you have permission to share. Please remove private prospect information.

• Your availability, US-hours coverage, and earliest start date.



Hiring Process

Application review → Short call → Setting role-play → Final interview → Offer and onboarding.



Growth & Leadership Opportunities

We’re looking for someone who takes this role seriously and wants to grow with the business. As we expand, strong performers who demonstrate consistent results, ownership, and the ability to support others can be considered for leadership opportunities.



Final Note

We value people who turn skill and effort into qualified appointments that actually happen. If you’re ready to own your results, improve your craft, and build a long-term role with growth potential, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Sales Representative (Bookkeeping & Accounting Experience)
description:
About Get My Books Right



Get My Books Right (
) is the bookkeeping arm of TAX DRx, a New York-based accounting and tax firm serving small business owners. Clients come to us to get clean books, accurate tax filings, and a clear picture of their numbers, and we meet many of them face to face at our office.

We are growing and hiring a full-time, remote Sales Representative based in the Philippines who understands bookkeeping and accounting well enough to talk to US business owners as a peer, not a script reader



You will own the front end of our client pipeline: taking inbound leads and booked consultations, uncovering what is actually wrong with a prospect's books, and closing them into the right bookkeeping, tax, or advisory package.



What You'll Do

• Run discovery and sales consultations with US small business owners by phone and video

• Review a prospect's current books, bank activity, and filing history to diagnose gaps and scope the right service

• Present clear proposals for bookkeeping cleanup, monthly bookkeeping, payroll, and tax packages, and close the sale

• Follow up with every lead and quote in the CRM until it is closed or disqualified

• Hand new clients off cleanly to the bookkeeping team with accurate notes on scope, pricing, and urgency

• Hit monthly targets for consultations held, close rate, and new monthly recurring revenue

• Keep the pipeline, notes, and activity current in the CRM every day

• Share what you hear from prospects so we can sharpen our offers and marketing

What We're Looking For

Required

• 2+ years of hands-on bookkeeping or accounting work (bookkeeper, staff accountant, tax preparer, or similar)

• 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience, speaking directly with business owners and decision-makers (phone or video) and closing deals

• Excellent spoken and written English; confident and natural on calls with US clients

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (or Xero) and the basics of reconciliations, P&L, balance sheets, and US small business tax filings

• Comfortable explaining financial problems to non-financial business owners in plain language

• Consistent, organized follow-up habits and experience working out of a CRM

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a good headset, and a computer that can run video calls

• Available to work US Eastern business hours full-time

Nice to have

• Experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or other professional services to US businesses

• Experience with US clients in restaurants, construction, real estate, or other cash-heavy small businesses

• Familiarity with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

• Prior work at a bookkeeping, tax, or CPA firm

• Bilingual English/Spanish



Compensation & Benefits

• Base pay &  per month plus uncapped commission on closed deals

• Paid twice monthly via your preferred method (Wise, PayPal, or local bank transfer)

• Paid time off and Philippine holidays observed

• Training on our service packages, pricing, and sales process

• A steady flow of inbound leads from our marketing, not cold-calling from a list

• Long-term, stable role with a clear path to a senior sales or sales lead position as the team grows



How to Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and attach your resume. Start your application with the word LEDGER so we know you read the full posting, and include a short note on your bookkeeping or accounting background and your B2B sales results. A short voice or video recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself is a strong plus.

We review applications as they come in and will reach out to schedule a first call with qualified candidates.

Get My Books Right is an equal opportunity employer.

title: SEO Specialist | Content, On-Page & Reporting
description:

Hi, I’m Tanya, founder of Lucky 44 SEO, a small Australian agency working with a lovely mix of businesses, retail many of them female-led.



I’m looking for an experienced SEO person who enjoys understanding a business, finding opportunities and getting stuck into the work. Someone who cares about the details, communicates clearly and follows through.



We’re a small, friendly team looking for someone to grow with us long-term. Good work, honest conversations and a sense of humour matter here.



The role



I’ll guide the overall strategy and client priorities. You’ll work closely with me and our team to turn that direction into research, content, on-page optimisation and completed website updates.



You should be able to take a client rundown, research their business and come back with sensible questions and ideas. Once we agree on the direction, you can get the work done without needing every step mapped out.



Our technical SEO specialist handles the deeper technical work, so your focus will be content, on-page SEO and reporting.



What you’ll do



- Research clients, customers, competitors and keywords, then map opportunities to the right pages.

- Write and improve service pages, location pages, collection pages, product descriptions and blogs.

- Optimise titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.

- Upload, format and check content across Shopify, WordPress, Wix, Squarespace and other platforms.

- Set up client projects in SEO tools and run Screaming Frog crawls, addressing relevant on-page issues and flagging technical findings.

- Help prepare monthly reports using GSC, GA4 and our reporting tools, checking the numbers and explaining results, completed work and next priorities.

- Manage and optimise Google Business Profiles.

- Help monitor Google Merchant Center and flag product listing or feed issues.

- Keep work organised in Notion, communicate through Slack and join our morning Zoom check-ins.



What you’ll bring



- Proven hands-on SEO experience with real businesses.

- Strong written English, Australian spelling and the ability to adapt to different client voices.

- A sound understanding of search intent and useful, customer-focused content.

- Confidence using Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Google Merchant, Screaming Frog and GA4.

- Experience with SEO platforms such as SE Ranking, Semrush or Ahrefs.

- Reliable, good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

- Reliable communication. If something is unclear or running late, tell me early.



Notion experience will put you towards the top of our shortlist. 



Hours and pay



- Monday to Friday, four to five hours per day.

- Agreed working hours  with Australian business hours 9am - 3pm, including a short check-in at 9am AEST.

- Starting rate around ₱
per hour, depending on experience: approximately ₱8,000–₱15,000 per week.

- Potential to grow into full-time work if we’re a good fit.



How to apply

title: VoIP Support Specialist (NetSapiens / Viirtue) - Part Time
description:
Company: AirNetworks, LLC (San Antonio, Texas based MSP)



Hours: Part-time, approximately 20 to 25 hours per week



Schedule: Monday to Friday, covering US Central Time afternoon and evening hours. Typical window is 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM CST (which is 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM Philippines time, a comfortable morning shift). Exact hours flexible within that window.



Salary: $400 to $600 USD per month depending on experience



About us



AirNetworks is a Managed Service Provider based in San Antonio, Texas, serving clients in healthcare, legal, government, and business sectors across Texas. We manage multi-tenant VoIP infrastructure on the Viirtue platform (NetSapiens backend) and provide Microsoft Teams Direct Routing solutions through ConnectToTeams. We are expanding our team with a senior VoIP engineer who can take ownership of extension management, PBX configurations, and Teams voice integrations during our afternoon and evening coverage window.



What you will do



Primary responsibilities:



Serve as Level 3 VoIP expert for multi-tenant NetSapiens / Viirtue deployments across all client tenants.



Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Direct Routing deployments using ConnectToTeams platform, including SBC configuration, number provisioning, routing policies, and dial plans.



Handle complex extension management, call routing, IVR design, ring groups, call queues, and voi
 configuration across multiple client tenants.



Troubleshoot audio quality issues, SIP signaling problems, codec negotiation, and interoperability between NetSapiens and Microsoft Teams.



Configure and provision IP phones, softphones, and Teams-enabled devices.



Design and implement integrations between Viirtue / NetSapiens and Microsoft Teams Phone System via ConnectToTeams.



Document architectures, configurations, and runbooks for the VoIP practice.



Mentor and support junior technicians on VoIP best practices and troubleshooting approaches.



Serve as escalation point for complex voice issues that exceed Level 1 and Level 2 capabilities.



Participate in technical meetings with clients to present solutions, evaluate requirements, and design custom configurations.



Perform maintenance work and configuration changes during afternoon and evening hours when client impact is minimized.



Must have qualifications



Minimum 5 years hands-on experience administering cloud VoIP systems in a multi-tenant MSP environment.



Direct experience with NetSapiens or Viirtue platform (not just awareness, actual hands-on configuration and troubleshooting).



Direct experience with Microsoft Teams Phone System and Direct Routing (not just Teams chat and meetings).



Direct experience with 
 platform or equivalent Teams Direct Routing providers (such as Operator Connect, AudioCodes, Ribbon, or similar SBC providers).



Deep understanding of SIP protocol, SBCs (Session Border Controllers), dial plans, number translation rules, and Teams voice routing policies.



Experience provisioning and managing IP phones (Yealink, Polycom, Cisco, Poly) and Teams certified devices.



Business level English, both written and spoken. You will lead technical discussions with US clients.



Strong documentation discipline.



Reliable high-speed internet connection at your workstation.



Quiet workspace suitable for client calls and screen sharing sessions.



Ability to consistently work mornings Philippines time (7:00 AM to 12:00 PM PHT) which corresponds to US Central Time afternoon and evening.



Preferred qualifications



Previous experience working for a US based MSP.



Microsoft certifications: MS-721 (Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer), MS-700 (Teams Administrator), or equivalent.



NetSapiens or Viirtue certifications.



Experience with number porting, LNP processes, and E911 configuration.



Familiarity with Bandwidth, UNO SIP, or similar carrier platforms for SIP trunking.



Experience with ticketing systems (NinjaOne, ConnectWise, Autotask).







Experience designing hybrid voice architectures (traditional PBX plus Teams Direct Routing).



What we offer



Stable part-time remote work with a growing MSP.



Comfortable morning schedule in Philippines (no graveyard shift required).



Monthly salary paid on time via direct transfer.



Collaborative team environment with engineers in Mexico and the US.



Opportunity to contribute to the growth of a specialized VoIP practice.



What we are NOT looking for



Please do not apply if:



Your VoIP experience is limited to being an end user of a phone system.



You have never configured NetSapiens, Viirtue, or a similar multi-tenant cloud PBX platform.



You have no experience with Microsoft Teams Direct Routing or SBC configuration.



Your Teams experience is limited to chat, meetings, and basic admin (not voice).



You cannot commit to the morning Philippines schedule (7:00 AM to 12:00 PM PHT) that covers US afternoon/evening hours.



Your English is not comfortable for leading client technical discussions.



You are looking for a passive support role without direct client engagement.



How to apply



Please send your application including your updated CV and brief answers to these five questions to 
 your most complex NetSapiens or Viirtue deployment. Include number of tenants, extensions, specific features implemented (IVR, queues, ring groups, integrations), and any challenging issues you resolved.

Describe your experience with Microsoft Teams Direct Routing. What SBC platforms have you worked with (ConnectToTeams, AudioCodes, Ribbon, other)? Describe a specific deployment including the dial plan design and any integration challenges.

Have you integrated NetSapiens or Viirtue with Microsoft Teams Phone System? If yes, describe the architecture. If no, describe how you would approach designing such an integration.

Rate your English level for professional technical discussions with US clients. Describe a situation where you led a technical discovery or design discussion in English.

Confirm your availability to work mornings Philippines time (approximately 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM PHT), covering US Central Time afternoon and evening hours, for 20 to 25 hours per week.



Applications without answers to all five questions will not be reviewed.

Key Responsibilities



Account Management and Customer Relationships

• Manage an assigned portfolio of customers and serve as their primary relationship contact.

• Build strong relationships with business owners, finance teams, and other key decision-makers.

• Understand each customer’s goals, spending patterns, and account needs.

• Maintain clear account plans, records, and follow-up actions.



Account Growth and Sales

• Recommend relevant products or features based on customer needs and eligibility.

Customer Onboarding and Product Adoption

• Communicate customer requests accurately and set realistic expectations.

• Refer credit decisions, account restrictions, and exceptions to authorized teams.



Reporting and Customer Insights

• Keep customer records, account activity, and sales opportunities updated in the CRM.

• Prepare regular updates on portfolio performance, account risks, and growth opportunities.

• Ability to understand customer needs and translate product features into clear business value.

• Experience using CRM software to manage accounts, activities, and sales opportunities.

• Experience with corporate credit cards, business payments, spend management, or other financial technology products.

• Experience managing US-based business accounts.

• Experience conducting business reviews, presenting account insights, and developing account growth plans.

• Familiarity with financial statements, cash flow concepts, and business spending patterns.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

title: Executive assistant for US real estate agent– Proactive, Clear English
description:
Read This First

This is not an entry-level job, and it is not for everyone. If you want a list of tasks and someone to tell you what to do every hour, please don't apply. We read every application closely, and we will know if you didn't read this whole post.

About the Role

I run a busy real estate business in the United States. I need a full-time Executive Assistant who will take everything off my plate that doesn't need me personally. You will work with me and my current admin, Elizabeth.

When I call and say "handle this," you handle it, start to finish, without needing to be reminded. If you notice it needs doing before I tell you.

What You Will Do

• Manage my
 inbox: sort, reply, flag what matters, and keep it under control

• Plan my day and manage my calendar

• Book travel: flights, hotels, cars, and full itineraries

• Handle personal tasks for me and my family, like restaurant reservations, appointments, and gifts

• Enter and update client and transaction data in our real estate systems, including the Buffini platform

• Track leads and closings in our spreadsheets and keep them accurate

Input new listings into the MLS and fill in contract details from the information I give you, for my final review

Prepare showing packets and any other materials I need for buyers and sellers throughout the day

• Follow written checklists exactly, and turn my screen recordings of tasks into new step-by-step checklists so nothing lives only in my head

• Think ahead: spot problems, deadlines, and loose ends before they become my problem

• Find, vet, and hire freelancers for specialized work, starting with 1 to 2 skilled video editors for my real estate videos

• Manage those freelancers day to day: give them direction, keep deadlines, and send finished work to me for final review

Who You Are

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and do it.

• A fast learner. You can pick up new software quickly with little hand-holding.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Your speech must be clear and easy for American clients to understand on the phone, because you will call and
 clients, vendors, and restaurants on my behalf.

• Organized and detail-focused. Small mistakes in real estate cost real money.

• Reliable. When you say it's done, it's done.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs), or able to learn it quickly

• Real estate or executive assistant experience is a strong plus

Schedule and Pay

• Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time

• This means overnight hours in the Philippines. These hours are not flexible. Only apply if you can reliably work this schedule every week.

• Some flexibility for urgent after-hours requests is a big plus, but not required

• Pay: $7 USD per hour

• Long-term, full-time position for the right person

How to Apply

Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that don't follow them will be deleted without being read.

1. Start your application with the words "Ready to handle it" as the first line.

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, tell me about a time you solved a problem for your boss before they knew it existed.

3. Record a short video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself in English, and include the link. Speak naturally and look at the camera. Do not read from a script or a screen. Scripted videos will be rejected.

4. List the software and tools you have used, and rate your skill with Google Workspace from 1 to 10.

5. Confirm that you can work Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

How We Work

We use the 1:3:1 rule. When you bring me a problem, you bring 1 clearly stated problem, 3 possible solutions, and 1 recommendation. Your job is to give me back my time, not to hand me more decisions.

My best hours belong to attracting and working with clients. Anything else that pulls me away from that is your territory. You will always be looking for ways to make my day, and my business, run smoother. When you notice me getting bogged down in tasks I shouldn't be doing, you tell me, and you come with a fix, using the 1:3:1 rule. I would rather hear "you shouldn't be doing this, let me take it" than watch you wait to be asked.

Hiring Process

1. Applications are screened. Anyone who did not follow the instructions above is removed.

2. Finalists join a live, unscripted video interview with me. Then they complete a short paid test task, such as planning a sample business trip with flights, a hotel, and a dinner reservation.

3. The best candidate starts a paid 2-week trial. If it's a good fit for both of us, the role becomes long-term.

If you made it this far and you're excited instead of nervous, you might be exactly who I'm looking for.

title: SENIOR RECRUITER – TALENT ACQUISITION STRATEGY & ANALYTICS
description:
Schedule: Full night shift aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours



ABOUT THE ROLE



Starbond is looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter to lead end-to-end recruitment and develop effective hiring strategies to support our growth.



We need someone who combines strong recruiting skills with strategic thinking, data analysis, and sound judgment. Beyond sourcing and interviewing, you will assess hiring challenges, analyze recruitment performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend practical improvements.



You must have at least 10 years of total recruitment experience, including at least 4 years recruiting for U.S.-based roles, with demonstrated experience filling on-site positions.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Recruitment Strategy and Hiring Partnership



Partner with hiring managers to clarify business needs, role requirements, priorities, and hiring timelines. Create clear job descriptions, candidate profiles, screening criteria, and interview plans.



Develop sourcing strategies based on each role’s complexity, location, compensation, and available talent pool. Identify hiring challenges early, including compensation gaps, limited candidate availability, and restrictive requirements.



Recommend changes to sourcing channels, candidate profiles, job positioning, or selection processes based on results and market feedback. Help hiring managers distinguish essential qualifications from skills that can be developed after hiring.



End-to-End Recruitment



Manage sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate evaluation, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff. Recruit for U.S.-based, on-site roles and other positions across the organization.



Source through job boards, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, direct outreach, and talent networks. Build candidate pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.



Conduct structured interviews and submit clear candidate assessments supported by specific examples. Maintain timely candidate communication and proactively follow up on feedback and hiring decisions.



Recruitment Analytics and Reporting



Maintain accurate recruitment records and dashboards. Analyze the recruitment funnel, from applications reviewed and candidates contacted through interviews, qualified endorsements, offers, and hires.



Track time to first qualified endorsement, stage conversion rates, time to fill, sourcing effectiveness, offer acceptance, and candidate withdrawals. Investigate where candidates drop out or fail to progress.



Identify whether hiring challenges stem from sourcing, candidate qualifications, role attractiveness, or internal decision-making. Present reports explaining what the data shows, possible causes, and recommended actions.



Measure whether strategy changes improve candidate quality, conversion rates, or hiring speed.



Process Improvement and Candidate Experience



Improve recruitment workflows for efficiency, consistency, and candidate experience. Develop screening tools, interview guides, evaluation scorecards, communication templates, and recruitment SOPs.



Use candidate and hiring manager feedback to improve the hiring process. Apply recruiting tools, automation, and AI while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment.



Support structured onboarding and a smooth transition from candidate to new hire.



Additional HR Support



Assist with offer letters, contracts, onboarding documents, and other HR records. Maintain accurate and confidential candidate and employee information.



Support employee engagement, performance review coordination, training activities, and other HR initiatives as needed. Maintain recruitment as your primary focus while balancing assigned HR support responsibilities.



QUALIFICATIONS



At least 10 years of total recruitment experience, including at least 4 years recruiting for U.S.-based roles. Demonstrated success filling U.S.-based, on-site positions is required.



Proven ability to manage recruitment independently and advise hiring managers on hiring strategies and challenges.



Experience analyzing recruitment data, interpreting funnel performance, and turning findings into actionable recommendations.



Strong Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, direct outreach, and referral development skills.



Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, PivotTables, charts, and recruitment reporting.



Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills, with the ability to provide clear, evidence-based recommendations.



Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to prioritize multiple searches based on business urgency and role complexity.



Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, recruitment platforms, and relevant hiring practices.



High standards of professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity.



Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.



Availability to work a full night shift aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Hiring managers receive qualified candidates aligned with clearly defined requirements. Recruitment challenges are identified early and supported by practical recommendations.



Reports provide useful insights and next steps beyond activity counts. Hiring decisions progress through proactive follow-up and clear communication.



Recruitment strategies improve based on measured results.

About the Position



We are an established tax preparation business based in Fort Worth, Texas, seeking an experienced, highly organized U.S. Tax Operations & Quality Control Virtual Assistant to support our growing team during the upcoming tax season.



We are looking for someone with hands-on experience in U.S. individual tax preparation, IRS compliance, quality control, client file management, and team coordination.



This position requires someone who can work independently, identify errors, maintain organized records, and communicate directly with tax preparers to ensure all required documentation and compliance procedures are completed.



This is NOT an entry-level position. Previous U.S. tax preparation experience is required. During the busiest months hours will go to 40.



Key Responsibilities

Tax Preparation & Quality Control

Prepare and review individual U.S. federal tax returns (Form 1040).

Review Schedule C self-employment income and expenses.

Identify incorrect filing statuses, missing income, questionable deductions, and potential tax preparation errors.

Review returns completed by other tax preparers before submission.

Work within TaxSlayer Pro.

IRS Compliance & Due Diligence

Ensure preparers properly complete and save due diligence notes.

Client File Management & Organization

Ensure required signatures, supporting documentation, and preparer notes are saved.

Team Communication & Accountability

Monitor preparers' compliance with office procedures.

Track outstanding tasks and deadlines.

Escalate unresolved concerns to management.

Tax Office Operations & Reporting

Required Qualifications

Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time working hours.

title: Experienced Real Estate Acquisition Manager / Deal Closer
description:
About the Company



  We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in real estate wholesaling and fix-and-flip opportunities. We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisition Manager to join our team.



  This is a results-driven position for someone who understands the U.S. real estate investment market, has strong negotiation skills, and can independently evaluate properties to identify profitable investment opportunities.



  Our acquisition department consists of two primary roles. The Acquisition Specialist / Lead Manager is responsible for qualifying and nurturing seller leads. The Acquisition Manager takes over qualified opportunities, handles negotiations, underwrites potential deals, identifies investment opportunities through the MLS, and secures purchase contracts.

We are not looking for an appointment setter or entry-level real estate assistant. We need an experienced acquisition professional who knows how to analyze, negotiate, and close investment property transactions.



Primary Responsibilities



1. Seller Negotiations & Deal Closing

    *Take over qualified seller leads from the Lead Manager.

    *Communicate directly with property owners and negotiate purchase prices.

    *Build rapport and establish trust with potential sellers.

    *Identify seller motivation and determine opportunities to negotiate favorable purchase terms.

    *Handle seller objections, particularly when sellers are asking retail market value.

    *Develop negotiation strategies to bring sellers closer to investor-friendly pricing.

    *Present offers and negotiate purchase agreement terms.

    *Consistently follow up with sellers to move opportunities toward a signed contract.

    *Secure signed purchase and sale agreements that meet company investment criteria.

    *Work to convert qualified opportunities into profitable acquisitions.



2. Real Estate Underwriting & Deal Analysis



  *Analyze investment properties to determine acquisition potential.

  *Research comparable sales (comps) to establish accurate After Repair Value (ARV).

  *Evaluate property condition and estimate renovation and repair costs.

  *Calculate Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO).

  *Determine potential wholesale assignment fees and fix-and-flip profit margins.

  *Account for acquisition costs, closing costs, holding costs, and other expenses.

  *Identify potential risks that could affect the profitability of a transaction.

  *Determine whether a property meets the company's acquisition criteria.

  *Provide clear recommendations on whether to pursue, negotiate, or pass on a deal.



3. MLS Deal Sourcing & Property Filtering



  The Acquisition Manager will also be responsible for actively identifying potential investment opportunities through the  Multiple Listing Service (MLS).



  *Search MLS listings to identify potential wholesale and fix-and-flip opportunities.

  *Filter properties based on company investment criteria.

  *Identify distressed properties, undervalued listings, price reductions, and properties with extended days on market.

  *Analyze listing prices against comparable sales and estimated renovation costs.

  *Identify properties where sellers may be willing to negotiate below market value.

  *Monitor new listings and price changes to identify acquisition opportunities.

  *Contact listing agents and coordinate offers through the company's authorized real estate professionals.

  *Maintain a pipeline of potential MLS acquisitions.

  *Prioritize properties based on potential profitability and likelihood of securing favorable purchase terms.



4. Contract & Transaction Management



  *Prepare and submit purchase offers.

  *Negotiate contract terms and contingencies.

  *Coordinate with sellers, agents, title companies, and internal team members.

  *Ensure purchase agreements are completed accurately.

  *Monitor contract deadlines and important transaction milestones.

  *Maintain communication throughout the closing process.

  *Help resolve issues that could prevent transactions from closing.



5. CRM & Pipeline Management



  *Maintain accurate records of seller negotiations and acquisition opportunities.

  *Document offers, counteroffers, and seller objections.

  *Track all active negotiations and pending contracts.

  *Update CRM records and transaction statuses.

  *Provide regular updates on acquisition activity and deal progress.

  *Maintain an organized pipeline of potential acquisitions from both seller leads and MLS opportunities.



Required Qualifications & Experience



-Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in U.S. real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, or investment property transactions.

-Proven experience negotiating directly with U.S. property sellers.

-Demonstrated ability to get investment properties under contract.

-Strong understanding of real estate underwriting and investment analysis.

-Ability to independently calculate ARV, MAO, repair estimates, and potential profit margins.

-Experience analyzing comparable sales and evaluating property values.

-Experience sourcing and analyzing investment opportunities through the MLS.

-Strong understanding of wholesale transactions and fix-and-flip investments.

-Excellent spoken and written English.

-Strong negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

-Ability to work independently and make sound acquisition decisions.

-Comfortable working U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



**Experience working directly with U.S.-based real estate investors.

**Experience with real estate CRMs.

**Understanding of assignment contracts, double closings, and transactional coordination.

**A documented history of personally negotiating and closing wholesale deals.



Performance Expectations & KPIs



The Acquisition Manager will be evaluated based on:

Number of purchase offers submitted.

Number of properties successfully placed under contract.

Profitability of acquired properties.

Accuracy of underwriting and repair estimates.

Ability to negotiate below-market purchase prices.

Contract-to-close conversion rate.

Number of viable opportunities identified through MLS.

Consistency in managing negotiations and following up with sellers.

Overall contribution to the company's acquisition pipeline.



Compensation



+Competitive base salary based on experience.

+5% of the net assignment fee or net acquisition profit on each successfully closed deal.

+Additional monthly bonus based on deals closed per month

+Compensation will be discussed during the interview process based on experience and proven results.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit a resume and answer the following questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have in U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions?

2. How many real estate deals have you personally negotiated and gotten under contract?

3. How many of those deals successfully closed?

4. What is your experience negotiating with sellers who are asking retail market value?

5. Explain how you calculate ARV and MAO.

6. How do you estimate renovation costs when evaluating an investment property?

7. What experience do you have sourcing investment opportunities through the MLS?

8. What real estate software, CRMs, and property research platforms have you used?

9. Describe the largest or most profitable deal you have personally acquired.

10. Are you comfortable working U.S. business hours?



Interview Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a practical real estate underwriting assessment and a live seller negotiation role-play.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the acquisition process, think like a real estate investor, negotiate confidently, and consistently identify and secure profitable deals.
