title: ACCOUNTANT AND FINANCE OPERATIONS SPECIALIST
description:
Remote | Part Time | 20 Hours per Week

Starting Compensation: $500 USD per Month

Negotiable Based on Experience



IMPORTANT: A video application recorded specifically for this position is required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.



You must meet all requirements.



Please overview how to apply.



If you apply and details are missed, we will assume that you are not detail oriented and will have trouble keeping track of our numbers.







ABOUT HEAVEN BOUND



Heaven Bound Music Marketing helps Christian artists and organizations grow their audiences through intentional marketing, advertising, and artist development.



We are looking for an experienced accountant who can take ownership of our financial records, understand how money moves through the business, and communicate clearly with leadership.



This position goes beyond categorizing transactions. We need someone who reconciles accounts thoroughly, catches discrepancies, maintains accurate tracking systems, and turns financial information into useful cash flow projections.



An interest in Christian music and enthusiasm for our mission are a plus.





YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. QUICKBOOKS AND ACCOUNT RECONCILIATION



Accurately categorize transactions and reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.



Investigate unmatched transactions, missing payments, duplicates, processing fees, and balance differences until they are resolved or clearly documented.



Keep supporting documentation organized and maintain a clear record of corrections.





2. FINANCIAL TRACKERS AND INVOICE TRACKING



Maintain our Google Sheets and Excel financial systems alongside QuickBooks.



Match invoices to actual payments and verify amounts received. Accurately track service fees, advertising funds, expenses, deposits, refunds, credits, and owner distributions.



Ensure records agree across systems and that outstanding invoices and unpaid obligations remain visible.





3. PAYROLL AND COMMISSION VERIFICATION



Review employee and contractor payout records and monitor our sales commission tracker.



Verify commissions against approved terms and collected payments. Check that allocation percentages total 100% and flag discrepancies before payouts are finalized.





4. CASH FLOW AND FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS



Maintain a practical cash flow forecast covering expected collections, payroll, recurring expenses, upcoming bills, and debt obligations.



Help leadership understand available cash, upcoming shortfalls, and revenue needed to cover commitments.



Clearly distinguish confirmed figures from estimates and assumptions.





5. TAX PREPARATION SUPPORT



Keep records organized for our tax professional, maintain supporting documentation, and assist with routine tax related information requests.



Recognize when an issue needs to be escalated to a qualified tax professional.





HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK



ACCURACY WITH VERIFICATION



Check your work before marking it complete. Reconciliation means investigating differences, not adjusting numbers simply to make balances match.



CONSISTENT COMMUNICATION



Provide a brief written update on each scheduled workday covering completed work, unresolved questions, and anything requiring attention.



Respond to team messages within one business day and flag urgent cash or payment issues promptly during working hours.



PROACTIVE IMPROVEMENTS



Help us improve controls, simplify tracking, prevent repeated mistakes, and make financial reporting more useful.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



- More than five years of relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience supporting online businesses.



- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, transaction categorization, and account reconciliation.



- Strong Google Sheets and Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, conditional calculations, and troubleshooting discrepancies.



- Experience reconciling payment processors such as Stripe, PayPal, and Wise, including fees, credits, refunds, and transfers.



- Experience preparing cash flow forecasts and explaining financial results clearly.



- Basic knowledge of United States business taxes and experience supporting an external tax professional.



- Strong written communication, attention to detail, confidentiality, and reliable follow through.



- Experience with marketing agencies, digital agencies, or other service businesses is strongly preferred.



- QuickBooks certification is a plus.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This role requires 20 hours per week.



At least 12 of those hours must be worked between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday.



The remaining hours may be flexible by agreement. We need a consistent schedule with dependable overlap for questions, collaboration, and financial deadlines.



Starting compensation is $500 USD per month. We are willing to negotiate for a candidate whose experience and demonstrated abilities closely match the role (We would be willing to go a lot higher if you can prove your worth.)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Leadership can rely on the records without repeatedly checking your work.



Accounts are reconciled on an agreed schedule. Discrepancies are documented and followed through. Invoices and commissions are traceable. Upcoming cash needs are communicated early.



You can clearly explain where money came from, where it went, what remains outstanding, and what the business needs next.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without a video recorded specifically for this position will not be reviewed. Generic introduction videos do not meet this requirement.



Please include all of the following:



A THREE TO FIVE MINUTE VIDEO



Explain why you want to work with Heaven Bound, your relevant experience, and one specific example of a financial discrepancy you discovered and resolved.



Explain how you would keep our records accurate across QuickBooks and multiple financial trackers.



YOUR RÉSUMÉ



Include the types of online businesses you have supported and your responsibilities.



A RELEVANT WORK SAMPLE



Provide a financial report or cash flow forecast you created, with all confidential information removed.



YOUR AVAILABILITY AND COMPENSATION EXPECTATIONS



Include your availability in Central Time, your earliest start date, and your requested monthly compensation for 20 hours per week.



YOUR SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



Describe your experience with QuickBooks, Google Sheets, Excel, Stripe, PayPal, and Wise.



Applications with very low AP points will receive limited consideration. Relevant experience, a thoughtful video, clear communication, and demonstrated accuracy will carry the most weight.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid practical assessment using sample financial records to evaluate reconciliation, spreadsheet accuracy, discrepancy identification, and written communication.

title: GoHighLevel Lead Follow-Up Specialist / Virtual Assistant – US Dog Training Business (Full Time, US Central hours)
description:
I run a dog training and boarding business in Texas. Leads come in every day through GoHighLevel from ads, Google, and our website. The automation sends the first text and
 and offers them a calendar. After that, I need a human. That’s you.



THE JOB



Every lead gets followed up until they book or say no. You work the GoHighLevel pipeline all day: reply to texts and
s inside the hour, call the ones who don’t reply, move them through the stages, book consultations onto my calendar, and keep the pipeline clean so I can see at a glance who’s hot, who’s waiting, and who’s gone cold.



You own the calendar. Consultations, drop-offs, pickups, go-home lessons. You confirm appointments the day before, you chase no-shows, and you reschedule without me being involved.



You run the follow-up sequences. The 3-day, 7-day and 30-day follow-ups for leads that didn’t book, the review requests after a dog goes home, the reminders. If a sequence isn’t firing, you notice before I do.



You answer client texts and
s during the day: updates, questions, paperwork, payment reminders. Friendly, quick, in good English, in my voice, which I’ll teach you.



You report to me once a day in three lines: leads in, consultations booked, anything stuck.



THE HOURS



US Central time, 8 am to 5 pm Monday through Friday, plus Saturday mornings 8 to noon, because Saturday is our busiest day. That’s late night to early morning in Manila. If that doesn’t work for your life, don’t apply. This isn’t a flexible-hours job, it’s a be-there-when-the-lead-texts job.



Time tracked with Time Doctor. 44 hours a week.



WHAT I NEED



You know GoHighLevel. Not “I’ve heard of it.” You’ve worked pipelines, conversations, calendars or workflows in it.



You will pick up the phone. A lot of VAs won’t call. Half of this job is calling a lead back who didn’t answer the text. Your spoken English has to be clear and confident enough to talk to a Texas family about their dog.



You follow up until it’s dead. The money in this business is in the second, third and fifth touch. If you send one message and move on, this isn’t for you.



You’re on time, every shift, with reliable internet and a quiet place to make calls.



Dog knowledge is not required. I’ll teach you what you need. Caring about doing the follow-up properly is required.



WHAT YOU GET



Full time, long term, paid every two weeks, on time. Start this week. A 90-day review with a raise if you’ve earned it. 13th month. Paid holidays after six months. A boss who answers your questions fast and tells you exactly where you stand.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the words FIFTH TOUCH at the top of your application so I know you read this. Then send me three things:



A voice recording, under 60 seconds, calling back a lead named Sarah. She asked about training for her 1-year-old Labrador that jumps on guests, and she didn’t answer our text. Just talk to her the way you’d actually talk to her.

About us

We operate several brand on separate pricing engines and primarily through our own website, and major OTAs like Expedia and Priceline to travelers flying into Arizona. We're a small, data-driven team and already have several excellent remote team members in the Philippines.



The role

We're looking for a part-time revenue manager to own our forward pricing. Your daily task is to price the rolling 3-week booking window on both engines, by length of stay (2, 3, 4, and 5–9 day rentals), using competitor rates, booking pace, and seasonal demand. Beyond executing rate changes, we want someone who brings recommendations and provides insights we don’t see — someone who helps the owner make better pricing decisions, not someone waiting to be told what to do.



What you'll do



 • Daily: review the next 21 days on both pricing engines, compare against competitor rates, check booking pace, and adjust rates by length-of-stay bucket within agreed guardrails

 • Weekly: send a short report on what you changed, why, and where you believe we're leaving money on the table

 • Monthly: review how forward rates performed and refine the approach

 • Learn two different pricing systems and build a repeatable daily routine for each



Who we're looking for



 • 2+ years in hotel revenue management, OTA pricing/market analysis (Expedia, Agoda, 
), airline, or car rental yield management

 • Comfortable with pace, pickup, length-of-stay rules, and competitor rate shopping

 • Strong in Google Sheets / Excel; able to explain a recommendation clearly in writing

 • Self-directed and opinionated about pricing — you'll have authority to move rates within a band and flag anything outside it

 • Reliable daily availability (this task runs 7 days a week)



Hours and pay



 • 20 hours/week, roughly 3 hours daily.



How to apply

Please include:



 1. A short description of the revenue management work you've done and the systems you used

 2. One example of a pricing decision you made that was contrary to what your manager expected, and how it turned out

 3. Your available hours in Manila time



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid pricing exercise using real (anonymized) rate and pace data from our business.

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: USD $1,800–2,300 per month, depending on experience

🌍 Location: Fully remote

🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required)



🎁 What You Get

Your monthly rate is only half the package. You'll also get:

  4 weeks of paid time off

  Performance bonuses tied to results

  A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

  A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

  A team ready to run the services you design, and the training to make that happen

  Close work with our Director of Service Operations

  A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well. You'll design new services, prove they work, turn them into processes a team can run, and maintain their quality over time. Link building is your core strength, and you bring a full understanding of SEO, so you can help build services across the whole picture.



Some examples of what we want to build:

  New types of link building beyond what we offer today

  Our own sites for link placement

  Buying expired and auction domains, then restoring them

  Link exchange programs run at scale



Your day-to-day:

  Build new services: find and design new SEO services we can sell and deliver

  Expand our offer: turn opportunities in Local SEO, GEO, AI visibility, listicles and Digital PR into services we can deliver at scale

  Grow the publisher network: build strong publisher relationships, negotiate prices, and run outreach at scale

  Protect link quality: set vetting standards that go beyond DR and traffic, and keep risky or spammy sites out of our network

  Shape link strategy: define best practice for anchor text mix, link velocity, relevance and target page selection

  Audit and analyze: run backlink audits and competitor link gap analysis to find new opportunities

  Apply the full SEO picture: work with our Director of Service Operations to bring on-page and technical knowledge (site speed, keyword targeting, site health) into how we vet sites and shape new services

  Set content standards: define briefs and quality bars for placement content, including how to spot low-quality AI content

  Systemize: turn each service into a repeatable process with SOPs and quality checks

  Train the people who run those services

  Maintain: monitor quality and results, fix what breaks, and update processes as SEO changes

  Measure: track links that stay live and get indexed, how long they last, and their impact on rankings and AI visibility

  Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  Deep, hands-on SEO experience, with real strength in off-page and link building

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

  Experience with domain auctions, expired domain vetting and site restoration

  Hands-on skill with Ahrefs and Semrush, plus outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Hunter

  Proof that you have built a service or process from scratch and kept it running well over time

  Experience leading or training a team

  Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

Have an agency or link-selling background

Have experience with domain marketplaces and expired domain tools

Are comfortable with numbers: cost per link, margins and capacity planning



🎯 Your First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  Learn our current services, publisher network and quality standards

  Audit our off-page processes and present your top improvement opportunities

  Propose at least one new service with a clear plan, cost model and SOP

  Launch that service as a pilot, with a team trained to run it



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same steps:

1. Application + portfolio. For two or three services, processes or link projects you built, tell us what you made and what your role was, how it performed (links live, indexed, retention, rankings, margins), and what you learned and would do differently.

2. First interview with MJ, our Head of Operations. A conversation about your experience, how you vet link quality, your grasp of on-page and technical SEO basics, and how you turn an idea into a process a team can run.

3. Final interview with our CEO and COO. A deeper conversation on how you would build and pilot a new service, and how you work within agreed standards.



📬 How to Apply (Follow These Steps Precisely)

Please
 the following to 
 with the subject: "SEO Manager – I'm [Your Name] and I Build SEO Services That Scale"

Include:

   1. Your resume with two professional references

   2. Your portfolio, with results for two or three services, processes or link projects you built (what you made, how it performed, and what you learned)



Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

Work Setup: Fully Remote / Work From Home



About the Role



We are looking for a skilled, proactive, and technically capable E-Commerce Virtual Assistant who can build, launch, manage, and optimize online stores.



This is NOT a customer service-focused position.



We need someone who understands the technical and operational side of e-commerce and can take a store from concept to launch, including setting up the platform, configuring products, integrating tools, and ensuring everything functions properly.



The ideal candidate is someone who can work independently, solve technical problems, and build an e-commerce store from scratch rather than simply manage customer inquiries or perform basic administrative tasks.



Key Responsibilities



E-Commerce Store Development



Build and set up e-commerce stores from scratch using platforms such as Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar.



Customize storefront layouts, themes, navigation, and product pages.



Set up product catalogs, collections, categories, and variants.



Configure payment gateways, shipping options, taxes, and checkout processes.



Ensure stores are mobile-friendly, functional, and ready for launch.



Store Management & Optimization



Manage and maintain existing e-commerce stores.



Upload and optimize product listings, descriptions, images, and pricing.



Install, configure, and manage third-party apps and integrations.



Troubleshoot technical issues related to storefront functionality.



Improve store navigation, user experience, and conversion performance.



Monitor store performance and recommend improvements.



E-Commerce Operations & Automation



Set up and manage order processing and inventory systems.



Implement workflows and automation to streamline operations.



Integrate relevant tools for marketing, analytics, inventory, and fulfillment.



Maintain accurate product and inventory information.



Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and store performance.



Qualifications



Proven experience building and managing e-commerce stores.



Hands-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or other e-commerce platforms.



Ability to create and launch an online store from scratch with minimal supervision.



Experience configuring payment gateways, shipping settings, product catalogs, and integrations.



Understanding of e-commerce operations, order management, and inventory systems.



Basic knowledge of website design, store customization, and user experience.



Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.



Excellent organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.



Nice to Have:



Basic HTML, CSS, or Liquid knowledge.



Experience with SEO and conversion rate optimization.



Familiarity with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or similar tools.



Experience with e-commerce automation and third-party integrations.



Experience launching multiple stores or managing different e-commerce brands.



Important: Who We're Looking For



We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on store development and technical e-commerce experience.



This position is NOT intended for applicants whose experience is limited to:



Responding to customer
s, chats, or support tickets.



Handling refunds, returns, and basic customer inquiries.



Using only basic CRM or customer contact management features.



Performing simple product uploads without understanding store setup or functionality.



Managing customer-facing tasks without experience in the backend operations of an e-commerce store.



Customer support experience is welcome, but it cannot be your primary or only e-commerce experience.



Our priority is someone who can independently build, configure, launch, troubleshoot, and manage a fully functional online store.



How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit:



Updated Resume – Highlight your e-commerce experience, particularly store development and management.



Loom Video Introduction – Briefly introduce yourself and explain your experience building and managing online stores.



Portfolio or Store Examples – Share links or screenshots of e-commerce stores you have personally built, configured, or managed. Clearly explain your contributions.



Please include in your application:



Which e-commerce platforms have you worked with?



Have you built an online store from scratch? If yes, describe your role in the process.



What technical aspects of store setup can you handle independently?



We are looking for someone who can do more than maintain a store — we want someone who can build one.

title: Senior Paralegal / Senior Legal Assistant – Civil Litigation or Intellectual Property
description:
**About the Role**



The Law Office of Herbert T. Patty is seeking an experienced Senior Paralegal or Senior Legal Assistant with a strong background in civil litigation or intellectual property.



This is a senior role requiring someone who can independently manage substantive legal support work, anticipate case needs, take ownership of deadlines, and deliver accurate, well-organized work with minimal supervision. All substantive legal work will remain subject to attorney review and direction.



Experience in either civil litigation or intellectual property is required. Experience in both is an advantage.



**Key Responsibilities**



- Take ownership of assigned matters’ legal support workflows, documentation, deadlines, and follow-ups.

- Prepare and review drafts of legal documents, correspondence, and supporting materials for attorney approval.

- Conduct legal and factual research and provide clear, concise summaries.

- Maintain accurate case calendars and proactively monitor filing deadlines and procedural requirements.

- Organize and review case files, identify missing information, and follow up to keep matters moving.

- Coordinate with clients, courts, opposing counsel, vendors, and other parties as directed.

- Provide concise status updates and promptly flag risks, delays, or decisions requiring attorney attention.

- Review work for accuracy, completeness, formatting, and compliance with applicable requirements before attorney review.

- Help improve legal support procedures and provide guidance to junior support staff when needed.

- Perform additional related duties based on case requirements and the evolving needs of the role.



**Practice-Specific Responsibilities**



Responsibilities will depend on your area of expertise and assigned matters.



**Civil Litigation**



- Draft pleadings, motions, discovery requests and responses, and other litigation documents for attorney review.

- Coordinate document collection, review, and production.

- Prepare exhibits, chronologies, deposition materials, and hearing or trial preparation files.

- Coordinate court filings and service, verify filing acceptance, and maintain supporting records.

- Track case activity and applicable court rules and deadlines.



**Intellectual Property**



- Support patent, trademark, and/or copyright matters within your area of experience.

- Prepare application materials, filings, and correspondence for attorney review.

- Maintain accurate intellectual property portfolios and docketing records.

- Monitor application status, official correspondence, and upcoming deadlines.

- Assist with responses, renewals, maintenance filings, and supporting research as applicable.



**Required Qualifications**



- Substantial experience as a paralegal or legal assistant, including senior-level responsibility in civil litigation or intellectual property.

- Experience supporting a U.S. legal practice and familiarity with the procedures relevant to your practice area.

- Demonstrated ability to manage substantive assignments from initial instruction through completion with minimal supervision.

- Strong legal research, drafting, proofreading, and document preparation skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication.

- Strong deadline management, organization, and attention to detail.

- Ability to anticipate next steps, identify problems, and exercise sound judgment about when to escalate.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, PDF editing tools, legal research platforms, and relevant case management or filing systems.

- Professional discretion when handling confidential and privileged information.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work setup.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience supporting a US law practice.

- A degree in law, legal studies, or a related field, or a paralegal qualification.

- Experience in both civil litigation and intellectual property.

- Experience reviewing junior staff work or improving legal support processes.



**Work Arrangement and Compensation**



- Remote position.

- Weekly hours, schedule, required availability during Pacific Time, and anticipated start date will be discussed during the interview.



**How to Apply**



Please submit:



- Your updated résumé.

- A summary of your senior-level civil litigation and/or intellectual property experience, including the jurisdictions you have supported.

- Examples of substantive responsibilities you have managed independently.

- The legal research platforms, case management tools, and filing systems you have used.

- Your availability, and earliest possible start date.



Please use **“Senior Paralegal / Legal Assistant – [Your Name]”** as your application subject line.

title: Senior Medical & Dental Billing, Coding & Denial Resolution Specialist
description:
# Senior Medical & Dental Billing, Coding & Denial Resolution Specialist



**Minimum 7 Years of Experience Required | Full-Cycle Billing | Denial Management | Revenue Recovery**



## About Clarity Works AI



Clarity Works AI helps medical and dental practices recover outstanding revenue, reduce denials, improve collections, and maintain consistent cash flow.



We manage billing operations for multiple practices, handling everything from claim creation and submission to complex denial resolution and revenue recovery.



## Application Requirements



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your years of medical billing experience and dental billing experience, separately.

2. The specialties, procedures, and insurance payers you've worked with.

3. The EHR systems, billing platforms, and clearinghouses you've used.

4. Your experience independently managing multiple client accounts.



Qualified candidates will be required to complete a practical billing and denial resolution assessment before receiving an offer.



## About the Role



We're looking for a highly experienced Medical & Dental Billing Specialist with at least **7 years of hands-on experience in full-cycle billing, coding, denial management, and accounts receivable recovery.**



**We are not looking for someone who only knows how to submit claims.** We need someone who understands the entire revenue cycle and has the experience to resolve difficult billing problems, recover unpaid claims, and independently manage client accounts.



The right candidate can build and submit claims from provider documentation, investigate complex denials, interpret payer responses, prepare appeals, challenge incorrect payment decisions, and follow claims through to resolution.



You should also know how to identify problems affecting an account's financial performance. If collections are declining, claims aren't being submitted, or payments are taking too long, we expect you to recognize the issue, investigate it, and take action without waiting for management to intervene.



This position requires someone who is technically strong, organized, resourceful, and accountable for results.



## Key Responsibilities



### Full-Cycle Medical & Dental Billing and Coding



- Independently manage billing for assigned medical and dental practices.

- Review clinical documentation and create accurate claims from scratch.

- Apply appropriate ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, CDT codes, and modifiers, as applicable.

- Review documentation to ensure billed services are supported and appropriate reimbursement opportunities are captured.

- Submit clean claims promptly and monitor acceptance.

- Identify missing charges, unbilled visits, incomplete documentation, and claims approaching timely filing deadlines.

- Handle insurance verification, claim corrections, payment posting, and reimbursement reconciliation.

- Review EOBs and ERAs to identify incorrect payments, adjustments, and discrepancies.

- Work with providers to obtain missing documentation, including clinical notes, narratives, X-rays, and other supporting records.



### Denial Management, Appeals & Revenue Recovery



**This is a major part of the position. We need someone with extensive, hands-on experience working denials and recovering unpaid claims.**



- Independently investigate and resolve medical and dental claim denials.

- Understand and interpret denial codes, CARC/RARC codes, EOBs, ERAs, and payer explanations.

- Determine the actual cause of a denial rather than simply correcting and resubmitting claims.

- Prepare and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and formal appeals with appropriate supporting documentation.

- Resolve denials involving medical necessity, authorization, eligibility, coordination of benefits, coding, modifiers, bundling, timely filing, and payer processing errors.

- Challenge incorrect payer decisions using payer policies, contract terms, clinical documentation, and applicable billing guidelines.

- Investigate underpayments and identify opportunities to recover additional reimbursement when supported by documentation and contractual terms.

- Follow up with payers, obtain reference numbers, escalate unresolved issues, and track claims until a final resolution is reached.

- Work complex and aged A/R, including claims over 90 and 120 days.

- Identify recurring denial patterns, determine their root causes, and recommend corrections to prevent future denials.

- Recognize when a claim should be corrected, appealed, escalated, or appropriately written off.



**We expect you to know how to get difficult claims paid, not simply document that they were denied.**



### Client Account Ownership & Performance



- Take responsibility for the overall billing health of assigned client accounts.

- Monitor daily claim submissions, rejections, denials, unpaid claims, and collections.

- Actively investigate claims that remain unpaid beyond 14 days, including claims already accepted by the payer.

- Identify unexpected declines in submissions, charges, payments, or collections.

- Review unbilled services regularly to ensure revenue isn't being missed.

- Prioritize work based on financial impact, timely filing deadlines, and account needs.

- Maintain accurate tracking of outstanding claims, follow-up dates, payer responses, and unresolved issues.

- Provide management with clear updates on account performance, problems identified, actions taken, and expected next steps.

- Identify workflow problems and recommend solutions to improve reimbursement and reduce recurring issues.



### Problem-Solving, Accountability & Follow-Through



- Independently investigate problems using EHR systems, clearinghouses, payer portals, provider manuals, and other available resources.

- Take initiative to resolve issues rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

- Follow through on outstanding claims and tasks until they are resolved or a documented final determination is reached.

- Escalate issues appropriately, explaining what has already been investigated and what action is needed.

- Communicate directly with insurance companies, providers, and office staff to resolve billing obstacles.

- Identify and address recurring problems rather than repeatedly handling the same issue.

- Keep leadership informed of issues that could affect submissions, collections, or timely filing.

- Take responsibility for assigned accounts and the quality of work performed.



## Required Qualifications



**Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:**



- Minimum 7 years of professional, hands-on medical and/or dental billing experience.

- Extensive experience in full-cycle billing, from claim creation through payment posting and reconciliation.

- Strong knowledge of medical and/or dental coding, including the ability to review documentation and create claims independently.

- **Proven experience independently resolving complex claim denials, preparing appeals, and recovering unpaid revenue.**

- Strong experience working aged A/R and following up directly with insurance companies.

- Ability to interpret EOBs, ERAs, payer denial codes, and reimbursement guidelines.

- Experience identifying denial patterns and addressing underlying billing problems.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple client accounts.

- Strong understanding of payer requirements, timely filing, authorizations, eligibility, coordination of benefits, and reimbursement rules.

- Proficiency with EHR/EMR systems, practice management software, clearinghouses, and payer portals.

- Strong organizational skills, independent problem-solving ability, and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to communicate clearly with providers, payers, clients, and management.



**Preferred:** Substantial experience in both medical and dental billing, experience with multiple specialties, and prior employment with a revenue cycle management company.



## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role



We're looking for someone who:



- **Knows billing and denials.** You can create claims, identify coding issues, investigate denials, prepare appeals, and recover payments without needing someone to walk you through the process.

- **Takes ownership.** You know the status of your assigned accounts and don't wait for someone else to identify problems.

- **Finds solutions.** When a claim isn't paying, you investigate why, determine the next steps, and keep working toward resolution.

- **Follows through.** You don't consider a claim handled simply because you called the payer or left a note.

- **Recognizes patterns.** You notice recurring denials, submission gaps, and payment delays and work to correct the underlying cause.

- **Works independently.** You know how to research payer requirements, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple accounts without constant supervision.

- **Focuses on results.** You understand that the goal isn't just to process claims. It's to help practices collect the money they're entitled to receive.



## Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Timely and accurate submission of billable claims.

- Claim acceptance and rejection rates.

- Denial resolution and successful appeals.

- Recovery of outstanding and underpaid claims.

- Consistent follow-up on claims unpaid beyond 14 days.

- Reduction in aged accounts receivable.

- Identification and prevention of recurring billing issues.

- Overall billing health of assigned accounts.

- Communication, organization, and follow-through.



## Who Should Not Apply



This position is not suitable for candidates who:



- Have fewer than 7 years of hands-on billing experience.

- Only have experience submitting claims prepared by others.

- Have limited experience investigating denials or preparing appeals.

- Routinely forward difficult claims to supervisors instead of investigating them.

- Only work claims from assigned task lists without monitoring the overall account.

- Require frequent reminders to follow up on unpaid claims.

- Consider a claim complete after a single payer call or resubmission.

- Are uncomfortable independently managing multiple accounts.

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Dry Ground AI



Dry Ground AI helps mid-market companies become AI native. We design, build and run custom software, AI agents and automation workflows that operate in production for real businesses, not demos. We are a fully remote team working with clients across the U.S.



The role



We are looking for a senior AI Engineer who can own features end to end: the interface, the backend, the integrations and the AI behavior behind them. You are a strong software engineer first, with the judgment to apply AI where it creates real business leverage.



This is a generalist role. You will move between client projects as priorities shift, so we value people who can hit the ground running, pick up a new codebase quickly and keep momentum when switching from project A to project B.



Quality and security are part of how we build, not a separate step. Our engineers ship through Kaiken, our AI-assisted delivery workflow, with automated tests, Playwright end-to-end checks and security scanning on every change. You write the tests that prove your feature works.



What you will do



• Design, build and ship full-stack applications with React and TypeScript on the front end and Node.js or Python on the backend

• Build AI agents, conversational interfaces and multi-step workflows using LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph

• Connect AI systems to the tools our clients run on: CRMs, property management and CMS platforms, data sources and internal tools, through REST APIs, webhooks and automation platforms such as n8n

• Plan how each new feature will be tested, then write and maintain the automated tests and evaluations for it

• Design for production: authentication and permissions, observability, error handling, and performance under real user load

• Work directly with engagement managers and clients to scope solutions, estimate effort and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language

• Review code and help raise engineering standards across the team



What we are looking for



• 5 or more years as a full-stack or senior software engineer

• Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on React experience

• Backend experience with Node.js and/or Python, including API design and integrations

• AI features you have shipped to production and supported, not only prototypes

• Working knowledge of LLM tooling (OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, LangChain or similar), prompt and context design, and retrieval-augmented generation

• Habit of writing automated tests; experience with Playwright, Cypress or similar

• Daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, with Git and GitHub

• Fluent written and spoken English; you will join client calls and write client-facing updates



Nice to have



• Security experience: secure coding, secrets management, access control, dependency scanning

• CI/CD and cloud deployment, ideally AWS (GitHub Actions, containers, managed databases)

• Capacity planning and scaling, such as moving a system from SQLite to Postgres or handling traffic spikes

• Vector databases, embeddings, OCR or document-extraction pipelines

• Voice AI, real-time or event-driven systems

• Consulting or agency background with direct client delivery



What we offer



• Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses

• Fully remote, flexible schedule

• High ownership: your decisions shape how our systems are built

• Real AI systems in production across multiple industries

• Training and development support



How to apply



• Please submit your resume and portfolio with two or three relevant examples of your work.

• Submit a 1 to 2 minute video explaining to a non-technical business owner what an AI agent is and how it could help their business.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
We're a permanent and holiday/Christmas lighting installer company serving Virginia, Maryland, and North Carolina. We're looking for a highly experienced Virtual Assistant who has already worked in sales and customer-facing roles with US clients. You should be able to hit the ground running, manage a full daily workload on your own, and represent our company with confidence. This is a long-term, full-time role. We have clear, documented processes and will train you on our systems, but we need someone who already knows how to sell, follow up, and stay organized without hand-holding.



You'll be responsible for:



1. Inbound Lead Calls. When new leads come in, call them promptly to answer questions, build rapport, qualify them, and book a free estimate or design consultation. You'll be the first voice these homeowners hear, so you need proven experience making customers comfortable, earning their trust quickly, and moving them toward booking. Speed matters most during our busy season (September–December).

2. Commercial Outreach. Research businesses and properties in our service area that would benefit from permanent lighting, using Google Maps, Google Search and listing sites. Targets include restaurants, retail centers, apartment communities, HOAs, churches, property managers and home builders. Log leads in our CRM and send personalized cold
s and follow-ups to book on-site consultations. The target is 25–40 outreaches per day, and every one must be personalized.

3. Customer Follow-Up & Referrals. Each morning, message the previous day's install customers to make sure they're happy with their lighting and comfortable using the app, so any issues get caught early. 4. Upsells & Past-Customer Sales. Follow up with past customers, using their job history in the CRM, to offer add-ons. Examples include extending lighting to other areas of the home (garage, back of house, second story, landscape) and seasonal promotions. 5. Booking Appointments

6. Customer Service

title: CRM Manager/Cold Caller Dual position
description:
# GoHighLevel CRM Specialist & Cold Caller — Surplus Funds Recovery



We are hiring a reliable virtual assistant for a **dual position managing our GoHighLevel CRM and making cold calls** for our surplus funds recovery business.



We help clients recover funds that may remain after their property is sold through foreclosure. We need one person who can prepare and upload daily leads, manage the CRM, and call potential clients.



## PAY & BONUSES



- **$3 USD per hour**, including the one-week paid trial.

- **$50 bonus for each contract approved by our legal team.**

- **A bonus equal to 5% of the net profit on each case file that pays out in the future.** This bonus is payable after the case pays out and net profit is determined.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Tuesday through Saturday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Colorado Mountain Time.**



You must adjust your local schedule to match these hours, including Colorado’s daylight saving time changes. Break arrangements will be confirmed.



## DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



**8:00–9:00 a.m. — Lead Preparation and CRM Uploads**



- Download daily leads from **Excess Elite**.

- Arrange, organize, and format leads in **Excel spreadsheets** for upload into our CRM.

- Filter leads according to our criteria, remove duplicates, and flag incomplete or inaccurate information.

- Upload prepared leads into GoHighLevel with the correct fields, tags, and pipeline stages.

- Ensure leads are ready for calling immediately after upload.



**9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. — Cold Calling and Follow-Up**



- Call potential clients and clearly explain our surplus funds recovery services.

- Identify interested prospects and follow our qualification process.

- Record accurate call notes, update lead statuses, and schedule follow-ups.

- Communicate professionally and respectfully with potential clients.



## CRM MANAGEMENT



Our CRM operates on **GoHighLevel through XS Elite**. It is mostly set up and already A2P approved, but minor adjustments may be needed.



You must know how to:



- Set up, adjust, and troubleshoot automations, workflows, and triggers.

- Update CRM settings and pipelines as needed.

- Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up processes.

- Identify and resolve issues affecting daily operations.



CRM adjustments will be handled as needed alongside your daily responsibilities.



## REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel CRM setup and management.

- Ability to configure and troubleshoot automations, workflows, triggers, and settings.

- Knowledge of how to download leads from Excess Elite.

- Proficiency in Excel, including organizing, filtering, formatting, and preparing lead spreadsheets for CRM imports.

- Experience accurately importing leads into GoHighLevel.

- Previous cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

- Clear spoken English and a confident, professional phone manner.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and follow-through.

- Reliable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Availability to work the required Colorado schedule.



Experience in surplus funds recovery, foreclosure-related services, or real estate is preferred.



## ONE-WEEK PAID TRIAL



Selected applicants must complete a **one-week paid trial at $3 USD per hour**, following the schedule listed above.



During the trial, you will demonstrate that you can:



- Review our existing CRM and make necessary minor adjustments.

- Configure or adjust automations, workflows, triggers, and settings.

- Download leads from Excess Elite and prepare them in Excel.

- Filter and upload daily leads accurately into GoHighLevel.

- Make cold calls and professionally explain our services.

- Maintain accurate call notes, lead statuses, and follow-up records.



Continued employment will depend on your ability to perform both parts of the role, including your CRM skills, lead preparation, calling performance, accuracy, reliability, and professionalism.



## HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through **OnlineJobs.ph** and include:



1. A summary of your GoHighLevel experience, including automations and triggers you have set up or managed.

2. Your experience downloading leads from Excess Elite, preparing Excel spreadsheets, and uploading leads into a CRM.

3. Your cold-calling experience and any background in surplus funds recovery or related industries.

4. Confirmation that you can work **Tuesday through Saturday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Colorado Mountain Time**, and complete the one-week paid trial.

5. Your **WhatsApp number, including country code**, so we can message shortlisted applicants for immediate interviews.



**Please apply only if you have the skills to handle BOTH CRM management and cold calling.**

title: Operations Associate, Cleaning & Inventory Management
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines preferred

Schedule: Full-time, 40+ hours per week, with rotating shifts within 8 a.m.–10 p.m. ET

Compensation: $6 USD per hour

Reports to: CEO



Tools: ClickUp, Guesty, Google Workspace, Grok Bots, and ChatGPT



About the role

Settled In Stays manages furnished short- and mid-term rentals. We’re looking for someone to own cleaning coordination and inventory management so every property is clean, stocked, and ready before guests arrive.



You’ll coordinate cleaners, verify cleaning quality, track linens and supplies, and arrange replenishment before shortages affect a stay. You’ll work closely with the CEO and operations team to resolve issues quickly and build reliable processes as we grow.



What you’ll own



Cleaning and turnover coordination

Schedule and confirm cleanings around checkouts, arrivals, reservation changes, and property access requirements.

Follow T-48 and T-12 turnover checks to confirm assignments, timing, access, and supplies.

Monitor cleaning progress, follow up on delays, and coordinate backup coverage when needed.

Communicate special instructions, including pet stays, extra laundry, deep cleans, and approved early arrivals or late departures.

Flag any risk to property readiness early and coordinate a clear plan for resolution.



Cleaning quality and property readiness

Review cleaner photos and completion checklists against property standards before guest arrival.

Identify missed areas, stained or damaged linens, missing amenities, and staging issues. Request corrections and verify completion.

Coordinate inspections, re-cleans, and follow-up visits when necessary.

Investigate cleaning complaints, arrange a timely response, and document what needs to improve.

Report damage and maintenance issues to the responsible teammate with photos, relevant details, and urgency.



Inventory, linens, and supplies

Maintain accurate records of linens, towels, toiletries, cleaning products, and other guest supplies across properties and storage locations.

Coordinate regular stock counts with cleaners and local support teams.

Maintain agreed minimum stock levels and reorder points based on occupancy, usage, and delivery times.

Arrange approved purchases, deliveries, and transfers between storage and properties. Confirm items arrive and reach the correct location.

Track missing, damaged, or worn items and coordinate replacements.

Compare pricing, consolidate orders where practical, and document purchases and receipts within approved budgets.



Cleaner accountability and internal operations

Help source and onboard cleaners, including sharing property checklists, photo requirements, access instructions, and supply locations.

Track cleaner reliability, recurring quality issues, and completion times. Follow through on corrective actions.

Review cleaning invoices against completed work and approved extras, flagging discrepancies before payment.

Keep ClickUp tasks, inventory records, and relevant Guesty notes current.

Provide clear shift handoffs and daily updates covering upcoming turnovers, unresolved issues, and replenishment needs.

Improve SOPs and checklists when recurring problems reveal a gap.



What you’ll need

1–2+ years of experience in short-term rentals, property management, hospitality operations, housekeeping coordination, or inventory management.

Experience coordinating cleaners or service providers and following tasks through to verified completion.

Strong written English and clear, professional communication with cleaners, guests, vendors, and teammates.

Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing photos, tracking supplies, and managing schedules.

Ability to prioritize multiple turnovers and resolve routine issues independently.

Experience with ClickUp, Asana, 
, or a similar task management tool.

Comfort using Google Workspace and spreadsheets to track stock, purchases, and operating records.



Nice to have

Experience with Guesty, Hostfully, OwnerRez, or another property management system.

Familiarity with cleaning checklists, photo-based quality checks, linen rotation, and laundry coordination.

Experience with purchasing, supplier coordination, stock reconciliation, or preparing new properties for launch.

Experience using AI tools to organize work and improve processes while checking their output for accuracy.



What success looks like in your first 90 days

No missed cleanings caused by scheduling or follow-up oversight.

Every turnover has a confirmed cleaner, completion deadline, and documented readiness check.

Cleaning issues are identified promptly, with corrections verified before arrival whenever possible.

Inventory records are current, and replenishment is arranged before supplies fall below agreed minimums.

Purchases, deliveries, and cleaning invoices are documented accurately.

Routine cleaning and inventory issues are handled independently, with clear escalation when needed.



Growth opportunity

Strong performers can grow into the Operations Manager role as Settled In Stays expands, with responsibility for leading operations staff, managing vendor performance, and making broader operating decisions.



We value initiative, sound judgment, and follow-through. We’re looking for someone who anticipates problems, brings solutions, and takes ownership through completion.



Hiring process

30-minute interview.

Paid practical assessment covering turnover coordination, a cleaning quality issue, and an inventory replenishment scenario.

Reference check.



How to apply

Please include:

A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

One example of a cleaning, turnover, or inventory issue you handled, including how you verified it was resolved.

The software and tools you’ve used.

Your current availability for rotating shifts within the stated coverage window.

The largest number of properties or weekly turnovers you’ve supported at one time.

The phrase “5-Star Operations” so we know you read the full posting.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
Are you the type of salesperson who loves closing deals, hates leaving money on the table, and knows how to turn a “let me think about it” into a booked job? We want you on our team!



JT is looking for a driven, confident, and highly organized Inside Sales Representative who knows how to sell over the phone. We're not looking for someone who simply answers inquiries and sends quotes. We need someone who takes ownership of every lead, follows up consistently, handles objections, and turns potential customers into paying customers.



If you enjoy talking to people, chasing opportunities, hitting targets, and seeing your hard work translate into results, this could be the perfect role for you.



What You'll Be Doing

Close sales over the phone. Turn inbound inquiries into booked jobs by building rapport, asking the right questions, presenting solutions, and confidently asking for the sale.

Move fast on new leads. Contact new inquiries within 5 minutes whenever possible. Speed matters, and we don't want good leads going cold.

Follow up like a pro. Call, text, and reconnect with customers who haven't booked yet. One call is rarely enough, and you'll know when to keep the conversation going.

Turn estimates into sales. Follow up on open quotes, address concerns, overcome price objections, and help customers make a decision.

Manage a busy pipeline. Keep track of new leads, callbacks, text conversations, pending estimates, and scheduled jobs without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Keep the CRM updated. Record accurate notes, track every conversation, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.

Coordinate with the team. Help customers with scheduling, answer questions, and ensure a smooth experience from the first call to the booked job.

Hit your numbers. Work toward daily sales goals, strong conversion rates, and consistent performance.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a salesperson first, not just a customer service representative.



You might be a great fit if you:

Have 2–5+ years of experience in inside sales, telesales, appointment setting, or phone-based sales.

Are comfortable spending most of your workday making and receiving calls.

Know how to handle objections, discuss pricing, and confidently ask customers to buy.

Don't give up after one unanswered call or one “not right now.”

Can manage multiple conversations and tasks without losing track of important details.

Are comfortable using CRMs, phone systems, text messaging platforms, and scheduling tools.

Communicate in clear, natural, professional English.

Take ownership of your results and don't need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

Are competitive, coachable, organized, and motivated by hitting targets.

Can take feedback, participate in call reviews, and work on improving your sales skills.

Experience in home services is a plus, but it's not required. If you've sold HVAC services, roofing, plumbing, cleaning services, insurance, automotive services, memberships, or other consumer services over the phone, we'd love to hear from you.



We can teach you our services and systems. What we can't teach as easily is the drive to pick up the phone, follow up, and close the deal.



What Success Looks Like

We want someone who takes every lead seriously and understands that every missed follow-up could mean a missed sale.



Here are the results we're working toward:



New leads contacted in under 5 minutes whenever possible.

A target booking/close rate of 50% or higher.

Consistent follow-up on every open estimate and sales opportunity.

A meaningful contribution toward JT's daily sales goal of $20,000+.

Accurate CRM records and a pipeline where no lead gets forgotten.

These are performance targets, not guarantees. Your ability to consistently execute, learn, and improve will matter.



What This Job Is NOT

Let's be clear about a few things.



This is not a passive customer service role where you answer questions and wait for the next call.

This is not a job where you send a quote and hope the customer gets back to you.

This is not a fit for someone who dislikes making outbound calls or following up multiple times.

This is not a role for someone who needs constant supervision to stay productive.

Some customers will say no. Some won't answer. Some will push back on price. That's part of sales. We need someone who stays professional, keeps moving, and knows how to create opportunities instead of waiting for them.



Why Join JT?

Work remotely from home.

Be part of a team that values initiative, accountability, and results.

Develop your phone sales, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Have clear performance goals so you know what success looks like.

Get the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's growth.

title: Amazon Product Research Specialist

title: Rental Real Estate Appointment Setter & Lead Conversion Specialist (Cold Caller)
description:
We are a Miami-based real estate team looking for an experienced, confident, and results-driven real estate cold caller who can handle both rentals and property sales.



We are NOT looking for beginners. We need someone with proven real estate experience, excellent English communication skills, quick thinking, and the ability to work independently. Miami real estate experience is a major plus.



Responsibilities



-Make cold calls and follow up with buyer, seller, and rental leads.



-Qualify clients by understanding their needs, budget, preferences, and timeline.



-Book and confirm property showings with clients and agents.



-Find alternative properties when a client's preferred unit is unavailable or unsuitable.



-Coordinate with listing agents to verify property availability and showing schedules.



-Follow up after showings, address client concerns, and maintain communication.



-Help move clients toward applications, negotiations, and successful deals.



-Keep client information, schedules, conversations, and follow-up tasks organized in our CRM.



Requirements



-Proven real estate cold calling experience is mandatory. Miami market experience is a plus.



-Experience handling both rentals and buying/selling is highly preferred.



-Fluent in spoken and written English, with a clear, confident, and professional phone manner.



-Quick thinker who can respond promptly, learn quickly, and make sound decisions.



-Resourceful problem-solver who takes initiative without waiting for instructions.



-Strong organizational, follow-up, coordination, and client-handling skills.



-Able to manage multiple leads and priorities without missing important details.



-GoHighLevel (GHL) or other CRM experience is a plus.



Work Requirements



F-ull-time position with a dedicated work schedule.



-Must be comfortable staying connected on Zoom and sharing your screen entire shift.



-Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet working environment.



-Must be accountable, responsive, and able to work independently.



Who We Want



We need someone who does more than make calls and book appointments. You must be able to think on your feet, help clients find suitable properties, coordinate showings, follow up consistently, solve problems, and help convert leads into closed deals.



No beginners. No basic-training candidates. Strong English, speed, initiative, and real estate experience are non-negotiable.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume, voice recording and a brief introduction explaining your real estate cold calling experience, including your experience with rentals, sales, booking showings, and client follow-ups. Miami real estate experience and GoHighLevel knowledge should also be mentioned, if applicable.

title: Sales Development Representative - Remote
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **Senior Sales Development Representative** to identify new business opportunities, establish strategic partnerships, and drive revenue growth. In this role, you will be instrumental in expanding our market reach by researching potential clients, generating high-quality leads, and securing qualified sales opportunities for our Catering Sales Team.



As a key member of our business development team, you will take a proactive approach to prospecting, engaging potential clients, and identifying opportunities that align with our business objectives. The ideal candidate is a confident communicator with strong analytical and research skills, a strategic mindset, and the determination to consistently achieve and exceed sales targets.



Key Responsibilities



- Research, identify, and develop new business opportunities through targeted prospecting and market analysis.

- Proactively engage potential clients through cold calling, LinkedIn outreach,
 campaigns, and other business development channels.

- Conduct market research and monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify potential growth opportunities.

- Evaluate and qualify prospects based on their business needs, purchasing potential, and alignment with our services.

- Build meaningful relationships with prospective clients by understanding their challenges and presenting relevant solutions.

- Manage and maintain an organized sales pipeline, ensuring qualified opportunities are effectively transferred to the appropriate sales representatives.

- Develop and maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, lead status, and sales activities within the CRM system.

- Prepare daily and weekly performance reports covering outreach activities, lead generation, pipeline development, and sales forecasts.

- Work closely with the Sales, Marketing, and Product Development teams to align business development strategies and support overall company growth.

- Continuously identify ways to improve prospecting strategies, lead quality, and sales development processes.



Requirements & Qualifications



- At least 2–3 years of relevant industry experience in sales development, business development, or a similar role.

- Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or supporting B2B clients is required.

- Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms, particularly Pipedrive or similar systems.

- Demonstrated ability to identify potential clients, generate qualified leads, and develop new business opportunities.

- Strong understanding of sales pipelines, prospect qualification, and lead management processes.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage decision-makers and business stakeholders.

- Strong research, analytical, and strategic thinking abilities, with the capacity to recognize market trends and growth opportunities.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple prospects and priorities simultaneously.

- Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.

- A proactive mindset with a strong sense of accountability and a commitment to achieving measurable results.
